title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer – Real Time Engineering
jobDescription: Senior Site Reliability Engineer – Real Time Engineering We are hiring Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to expand our team supporting LSEG’s Real Time application space. This space provides thousands of clients with access to trading and market data globally. Our team mitigates operational risk, enables fast product innovation, and continuously improves customer experience. As an SRE, you will take ownership of operational support, contribute to cloud migration initiatives, and help automate operational tasks. You will build and evolve observability capabilities, apply data-driven and AI-assisted insights, and develop strong domain expertise. You will work as part of a diverse, globally distributed team in a fast-paced environment that processes real-time data. Key Responsibilities Lead incident recovery efforts by analyzing complex situations, forming hypotheses, and coordinating effective recovery actions. Apply structured problem-solving and critical thinking to identify root causes across distributed systems. Produce clear, high-quality incident reports and participate in post-incident reviews to drive reliability improvements. Maintain production stability by assessing deployment risks and using operational data to identify reliability concerns. Automate operational processes and use AI-assisted tools to enhance observability, alerting, and troubleshooting. Develop strong understanding of application dataflows, dependencies, and networking topologies. Collaborate with development teams on backlog prioritization, project intake, operational acceptance testing, and Game Day activities. Technical & Professional Qualifications Experience with UNIX/Linux administration, scripting, and automation. Hands-on experience supporting cloud-native applications, preferably on Azure; AWS experience is an advantage. Understanding networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, UDP traffic, HTTP, and DNS. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container-based platforms. Ability to troubleshoot distributed systems using logical reasoning and data-driven analysis. Experience with observability tools; Data Dog and Big Panda experience is highly desirable. Familiarity with Git or similar version control systems. Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant industry experience; customer-facing operational support experience is a plus. Critical Thinking & AI-Enabled Engineering We value engineers who think critically, challenge assumptions, and make sound decisions in complex and high-pressure situations. Experience using data-driven insights and AI-assisted tools to improve observability, automate operations, or accelerate incident diagnosis is highly valued. title: Product and Pricing Master Modelling BA
jobDescription: ROLE SUMMARY We're transforming Finance at LSEG. As we move to Oracle Fusion and a single enterprise data model, we're simplifying processes, improving controls and creating stronger foundations for reporting and decision-making. As a Business Analyst, you'll help shape how Product and Pricing master data is managed across the Group. Working alongside Finance, Product, Technology and Operations teams, you'll turn business requirements into practical solutions that improve data quality, consistency and business outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to play a hands-on role in a large-scale global transformation and help define how master data supports the future of Finance at LSEG. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Partner with business and technology teams to define Product and Pricing master data requirements and solutions. Help design product hierarchies, attributes, classifications and controls that support finance processes and reporting. Support the implementation of Oracle Product Hub and related integrations across Oracle Fusion and other enterprise platforms. Facilitate workshops, analyse impacts and produce clear documentation to support delivery decisions. Identify data quality issues, process gaps and risks, helping drive practical improvements and stronger controls. Support testing, business readiness and post-go-live activities to ensure successful adoption of new capabilities. WHAT YOU'LL BRING 5+ years' experience in Business Analysis, Master Data Management or ERP transformation programmes. Strong knowledge of Product and Pricing Master Data, including hierarchies, attributes, classifications and governance. Experience with Oracle Product Hub, Oracle PDH, Oracle Fusion Item Master or similar PIM/MDM solutions. Ability to gather requirements, analyse complex problems and translate them into practical business solutions. Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills, with the confidence to work across business and technology teams. Experience supporting testing, implementation and change activities within large transformation programmes. Additional experience that would be beneficial Oracle EDMCS, enterprise hierarchies or reference data management. Finance Transformation or multi-ERP environments. Data migration, harmonisation and master data remediation. Understanding of finance reporting, product profitability or Chart of Accounts concepts. title: Data scientist
jobDescription: Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Data Scientist to help develop and deploy enterprise-scale AI and machine learning solutions that improve operational efficiency, service resilience and customer outcomes. You will work closely with software engineers, SREs, product managers, platform teams and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, build predictive models, evaluate AI solutions and take products from concept through to production. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with commercial awareness and the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and measurable business value. What You'll Be Doing AI & Machine Learning Solutions Design, build and deploy machine learning models to solve operational and business challenges. Develop predictive analytics capabilities focused on incident prevention, service health, operational risk and customer experience. Support the development of Generative AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems and agentic workflows. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend practical applications across the organisation. Data Science & Analytics Perform advanced statistical analysis and modelling across large-scale operational and engineering datasets. Develop feature engineering, experimentation and model evaluation frameworks. Create insights and recommendations that drive decision making for senior stakeholders. Build and maintain reproducible data science workflows and pipelines. Product Delivery Partner with engineering and product teams to transition solutions from proof-of-concept into production. Define success metrics and measurement frameworks for AI products. Support model monitoring, governance and continuous improvement activities. Contribute to AI product roadmaps and prioritisation discussions. Collaboration & Innovation Work with subject matter experts from Engineering, Operations, Service Management and Product organisations. Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Contribute to the growth of LSEG's AI and Data Science community through knowledge sharing and mentoring. Promote responsible AI, model governance and data-driven decision making. What You'll Bring Essential Experience Demonstrable experience delivering machine learning or AI solutions within a large-scale enterprise environment. Strong experience applying statistical modelling, predictive analytics and experimentation techniques. Experience working with structured and unstructured data at scale. Proven ability to translate business problems into measurable analytical outcomes. Experience taking models from development into production environments. Technical Skills Python and associated data science ecosystem (Pandas, Num Py, Scikit-learn). Machine learning techniques including classification, regression, clustering and anomaly detection. Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures or agent-based AI solutions. SQL and large-scale data analysis. Cloud-based data science platforms and MLOps practices. Data visualisation and storytelling tools. Desirable Skills Experience within financial services, regulated environments or market infrastructure. Familiarity with Azure AI services and Microsoft AI ecosystem. Experience with observability, SRE or operational analytics use cases. Experience developing AI-powered automation solutions. Knowledge of Responsible AI and model governance frameworks. Behaviours & Competencies The successful candidate will demonstrate: Strong problem-solving capability and analytical thinking. Curiosity and a passion for applying AI to real-world challenges. Customer-focused mindset with a focus on outcomes. Ability to work effectively across organisational boundaries. Ownership and accountability for delivery. Clear communication and stakeholder management skills. Commitment to continuous learning and innovation. Role Description: We are seeking a technically strong Analytics & Data Engineer to join our Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) Engineering team. This mid-level role is ideal for someone with a solid foundation in data engineering and analytics, who is ready to take ownership of technical delivery across multiple platforms and collaborate with global stakeholders. You will be involved across the full data lifecycle: from requirements gathering and analysis to architecture design, data pipelines, and go-life. You will leverage technologies such as SQL, Python, Postgres, and AWS. Your work will directly support our mission to detect and prevent financial crime through scalable, secure, and pro-active data solutions. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Data Requirements & Analytics Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and compliance teams to gather and translate business requirements into technical data specifications. Conduct data profiling, exploration, and root cause analysis to support solution design and regulatory reporting. Define and document data models, transformation logic, and data flows. Data Architecture & Engineering Design and implement scalable data architectures across the AWS infrastructure. Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines. Execution & Delivery Engage with architecture and operations teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards. Work in Agile teams, contributing to sprint planning, backlog refinement, and technical documentation. Participate in code reviews and ensure alignment to engineering best practices. Required Skills & Experience: Proficiency in SQL or Python for data manipulation and data analysis. Hands-on experience with AWS services including Postgres, Step Functions, Lambda, Glue, S3. Role profile: Reliability Engineer building the LSEG RTDMS market data managed service platform. ROLE SUMMARY: Member of the RTMDS build team. Supporting automation and production deployments. Planning and testing builds. Working with core engineering and development to develop functionality and resolve production deployment issues. Test configurations, automation and deliver infrastructure. Delivery to customers with excellence, reliability, sustainable and predictability. To achieve success the candidate will need to be committed, accountable, analytical, work well in a team and reactive to service impacting issues. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Supporting a private cloud hosting many hundreds of customers who historically led their own market data networks who will be both knowledgeable and expecting excellent service. You’ll be involved in the platform management ensuring compliance to standards and patching levels in production. Developing inventory to build new infrastructure and support RTMDS Architecture to build a stable environment that meets the demands placed on it. Resolve complex issues with build process, RTDS software configurations, inventory, hardware, custom configuration and providing fix forwards. Document processes and procedures. Ensure suitable monitoring is in place for production systems and working with core engineering to develop new monitoring. Working with development teams and engineering teams to produce complex automation to deliver mass infrastructure. Assist development teams to deliver functionality and resolve issues with their products. Work with QE teams to maintain CI inventory production pipelines have suitable testing to avoid issues and repeated failures. Work with network teams to test WAN and LAN delivery. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Must have a knowledge of RHEL and automated application deployment. Experience of an automation tools such as rundeck and advanced scripting with languages like Python. Workflow tools such as Service Now and Jira. Development tools such as Git and DX1. Nice to have experience of python, HPE synergy, ITRS, Big Panda and HPE Oneview. Should be inclusive, a great teammate and problem solver. You will need to be a leader to delivery teams, operations and our partners. WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: You’ll get a great sense of achievement and an opportunity to develop and grow. Work on new exciting platform as it develops. Be a member of a worldwide team that thrives with diversity and aspiration to be a world leading, ground breaking engineering force. We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take hybrid approach to workplace, this role is Digital first. title: Senior AI Analyst
jobDescription: Role Summary The Strategy, Insights & Performance team at LSEG supports people across the organisation by helping them work with information in clear and useful ways. In this role, you will be part of a welcoming and collaborative team. You will work with colleagues from different backgrounds and roles to explore questions, share ideas, and contribute to positive outcomes. You will have opportunities to learn how information and tools are used across the Research Insights & Analytics (RIA) group. This role is designed for someone who enjoys learning, teamwork, and contributing to shared goals in a supportive environment. What You’ll Be Doing Work with teams across RIA to shape and deliver AI‑enabled use cases, from early ideas through to adoption. Collaborate with business partners to explore opportunities where AI can support efficiency, insight generation, and decision‑making. Contribute to the evaluation and use of tools, methods, and approaches aligned with LSEG‑approved AI and analytics platforms. Support the development of AI solutions that align with LSEG governance, risk, and compliance requirements. Help embed AI‑driven insights into existing delivery channels, such as dashboards, reports, workflows, and client outputs. Support adoption by contributing to documentation, knowledge‑sharing sessions, and practical guidance for RIA users. Share perspectives on how AI insights can be applied within everyday workflows and decision‑making. What You’ll Bring Experience working with AI‑enabled or data‑driven solutions, including exposure to large language models (LLMs), in a business or enterprise environment. Experience supporting projects or initiatives that involve multiple teams, priorities, or stakeholders. Ability to help shape and structure business questions into AI‑, LLM‑, or analytics‑based use cases. Experience using or supporting enterprise tools and platforms, such as approved AI, LLM, analytics, data, or reporting solutions. Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain AI and LLM‑related concepts in accessible ways to a wide range of audiences. You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. If this role sounds interesting to you, we encourage you to apply and start a conversation. Nice to Have Experience working in financial services, data, research, or information‑focused environments. Awareness of topics such as AI governance, model risk, and responsible AI, with interest in applying these principles in practice. Experience using applied analytics or data science approaches, with exposure to tools such as Python, R, or SQL. Experience working with large or complex datasets in a business setting. Experience contributing insights to operational processes or client‑facing outputs. Exposure to change, enablement, or adoption‑focused activities. An organised approach to work, with attention to detail and an ability to manage priorities. Curiosity and a proactive approach to learning and continuous improvement. A collaborative, stakeholder‑focused mindset, with the ability to work effectively with others. A practical approach, with interest in delivering meaningful business outcomes. What You’ll Get in Return Support for learning, development, and career growth. Opportunities to work with people across many teams. Exposure to modern tools and ways of working. A supportive environment where different perspectives are valued. An inclusive workplace that encourages collaboration and wellbeing. Our Commitment to Inclusion We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. We value different perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels supported to do their best work. title: Manager: Customer & Market Research
jobDescription: The Manager will sit within the Insights & Analytics team and play a key role in delivering high‑quality research that advises business decisions. The role focuses primarily on quantitative primary research, with opportunities to support qualitative studies as needed. You will lead research projects across their full lifecycle and work closely with internal partners and external research agencies to deliver clear, relevant insights. What you’ll be doing You will manage end‑to‑end quantitative research projects, including: Partner with stakeholders to understand business questions and translate them into well‑defined research briefs Develop, programme, and test questionnaires using Qualtrics Manage survey launches, fieldwork, and progress monitoring Review data quality, carry out cleaning and validation checks Analyse survey results using tools such as Qualtrics, Excel, SPSS, or R Develop clear, concise insight presentations tailored for senior leaders You will also: Support qualitative research activities when required, including discussion guide inputs, transcript review, note-taking, and thematic analysis Work with external research vendors to align on timelines, sampling approaches, and quality standards Look for opportunities to proactively answer emerging business questions through research Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support a wide range of research needs What you’ll bring 7–10 years’ experience in primary customer research, with a strong quantitative focus and working knowledge of qualitative methods Experience working in leading research agencies (such as Kantar, Ipsos, Nielsen, or similar), along with at least three years’ client‑side experience Experience managing research projects from start to finish, including fieldwork coordination and vendor management Practical experience using Qualtrics for survey build, logic, analysis, and reporting Ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights and communicate them through well‑structured presentations Comfort working independently while managing multiple projects at the same time Collaborative approach with the ability to work effectively with a range of stakeholders Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to problem‑solving Proficiency in one or more analysis tools such as SPSS or R Desirable experience Exposure to financial services, B2B environments, or complex products Experience working on the client side Familiarity with statistical techniques or predictive analysis Experience tailoring insights for both senior and non‑technical audiences Experience with data visualisation tools (such as Power BI or Tableau) Ability to synthesise large datasets into clear, story‑led insights What you'll get in return: Opportunity to work on varied, high‑impact research across products and stakeholders. Hybrid working model with flexibility. Exposure to both strategic and operational aspects of research. title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET / Windows Services))
jobDescription: Position Overview The Senior Software Engineer (.NET / Windows Services) is a technical leader responsible for designing, developing, and supporting mission-critical Windows Services, backend processing applications, and enterprise integration solutions built on Microsoft technologies. This role focuses on building highly reliable, scalable, and performant long-running services that support core business operations, data processing, system integrations, and automation workflows. The Senior Engineer collaborates closely with Product, QA, Database, Infrastructure, and Delivery teams to deliver robust solutions, modernize legacy applications, improve system reliability, and establish engineering best practices across the software development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Windows Services & Backend Application Development Design, develop, maintain, and support enterprise applications using C#, .NET Framework, .NET 6+, and Windows Services. Build and enhance long-running background processing services, scheduled jobs, batch processing systems, and automation solutions. Develop and maintain integrations with internal and third-party systems using APIs, file-based interfaces, messaging technologies, and database-driven workflows. Lead modernization initiatives by refactoring or migrating legacy VB.NET and .NET Framework Windows Services to modern .NET platforms. Implement robust exception handling, retry mechanisms, fault tolerance, and service recovery capabilities. Apply engineering best practices including SOLID principles, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, and maintainable architectural patterns. Produce secure, testable, and high-performance solutions that support business-critical operations. Conduct comprehensive code reviews and mentor team members on development standards and best practices. Strong experience designing, developing, and supporting Windows Services, background processing applications, and scheduled jobs. Strong SQL Server expertise, including: Stored procedures Query optimization Database design Performance tuning Indexing strategies Experience implementing system integrations using APIs, file-based interfaces, messaging platforms, and database-driven workflows. title: Associate Manager, Central Compliance
jobDescription:
ABOUT US: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG. OUR PEOPLE: People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. Role Summary: The Associate Manager, Central Compliance will play an important role in promoting the Company’s strong culture of ethics and compliance through the delivery of daily business-as-usual tasks/processes and supporting project work where necessary. The ideal candidate will have some experience in Compliance or other function where advisory skills are utilized as the position will involve regular contact with employees at all levels across the Group. This role will be based in Bengaluru and will report to the Senior Compliance Manager, Central Compliance who is based in London. We are looking for someone who can commit to UK business hours (Monday-Friday 9am to 5pm) and ideally UK public holidays, however there is some flexibility with regards to the bank holidays. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop excellent working knowledge of key Central Compliance policies: Personal Account Dealing, Conflicts of Interest, and Gifts, Entertainment and Hospitality. Provide advice and guidance in relation to key policies to employees/stakeholders where necessary Provide day-to-day administration of the Central Compliance System (CCS) including review of declarations/requests. Undertake investigations of compliance policy/process breaches Deliver training across policy areas Undertake control/monitoring tasks in relation to above policy areas and support Management Information reporting which may involve Metric Stream Respond to queries and manage the team Inbox through participation in bi-weekly calls to identify and tackle any high-risk items. Work with the team head to deliver the Annual Compliance Certification including responding to queries and working through associated breaches Other responsibilities include updating employee support tools such as User Guides, videos and other documentation e.g. FAQ for PAD, COI, GE&H. To provide support to People Leader on ad-hoc tasks/projects. To work closely with the vendor support to enhance/make config changes to the CCS. Key behaviours, skills and experience required to be successful in the

ROLE:
Two to five years of demonstrable experience, working within Financial Services in a Compliance / Risk / Advisory / other second-line-of-defence function. Experience in Central Compliance/Control Room supporting the administration of conflicts of interest/employee compliance system (e.g. Star Compliance, My Compliance Office) desirable. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with employees across all Functions including the Business. Able to exercise discretion when required and demonstrate diplomacy. Time management, prioritisation, and organization skills; ability to work on multiple tasks simultaneously and deliver to deadlines. Versatile as the needs and demands of the team evolve. Technologically proficient in the use of MS Office 365 suite, specifically Word, Excel, Power Point and Teams. It would be an advantage to have a Compliance certification/qualification and/or project management skills or be working towards one. title: Content Operations Specialist
jobDescription:
Content Operations Specialist – HMDBLRICW Team (ICW Group) Role Overview The Content Operations Specialist will be part of the HMDBLRICW Indices Team within the ICW Group and will play a critical role in handling and maintaining index data across internal and external platforms. The role requires expertise in ICW data processes. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Index Data Management Handle index data across internal and external systems, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and consistency. Facilitate problem-solving on data and product-related issues, including database infrastructure challenges, and maintain robust operational procedures. Coordinates and reviews the work of Analysts, helping to train and develop them. Track and analyse all index vendor notifications and methodological or data changes. Perform impact analysis on products and coordinate with multi-functional teams to implement required content updates. Provide subject-matter expertise and innovative ideas to develop new ways of working, including automation of workflows using Power Apps and AI-based tools. Ensure workflow processes and operational documentation are current, standardized, and consistently followed. Projects and Team Support Handle key initiatives and projects related to index content management and Content Enhancements. Provide operational and technical support to the specialist team to ensure smooth delivery. Case Management and Quality Improvement Adopt a forward looking approach to understand business challenges, develop tailored solutions and deliver trusted support. Conduct trend analysis of client cases to identify root causes and recurring issues. Implement measures to reduce future case volume. Drive initiatives sought at case reduction and improvement of critical metrics. Key Skills and Competencies Solid understanding of index data, financial benchmarks, and market data processes. Demonstrable experience with Index Constituents and Weightings data management. Hands-on exposure to workflow automation, Power Apps, and AI-enabled tools is highly appreciated. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Build relationships with and external partners to understand their drivers and negotiate positive outcomes Ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. Qualification & Experience Bachelor’s /Master’s degree in Finance, MBA or relevant field. Relevant experience in Index data, index operations, Content Management, or markets domain is helpful. jobDescription: GG10- Assistant Controller The jobholder works independently or supports the Business Unit Controller in all aspects of accounting for an entity or a group of entities, work with 3rd Party providers for statutory and tax reporting, yearend submissions and other accounting areas. The objective is to ensure compliance with accounting policies and Local Tax & GAAP requirements. The jobholder is expected to interact closely with various groups including but not limited to Business Units, General Accounting organization, Group Finance, Tax, Treasury, Internal Audit and 3rd party providers and to manage the relationship with our local statutory auditors. Day to day responsibility: Ensure statutory, tax compliances with for a Country or a group of Countries, by working closely with service providers. Work with various business partners to ensure legal entities are accurately, completely and timely accounted for in the enterprise systems, as well as to ensure good controls of underlying processes. Ensure the month end close in adherence to reporting timetable, perform reviews to ensure that critical accounts are reconciled with underlying documentation, that transactions are coded accurately in line with relevant accounting policies. Liaise with auditors and ensure timely completion of statutory & tax audits. Participate in Balance sheet and cost reviews. This role ensures the efficient execution of procurement activities, including contract management, sourcing, RFP management, and supporting reporting and compliance tasks. As a member of the Group Procurement Co E team, the Senior Specialist will report into the GP-Co E Manager. Role combines strong operational execution with automation, data-driven analytics, and continuous process improvement to enhance procurement efficiency, compliance, and decision-making. experience across sourcing and contract processes Develop Power BI dashboards and reporting to track sourcing performance, contract lifecycle metrics, and generate actionable insights for interested parties Essential experience and skills required: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Law, Sourcing management, Procurement process management or a related field. 5–7 years of experience title: Senior Research Analyst, Flows
jobDescription:
Conducts, collects and provides research as part of a team that delivers information and consulting services to clients, leading data investigation during the course of research projects. Role Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities:
- Participates in design and development of quantitative and data-driven models as needed
- Actively communicates within their team, as well as with peers across the organization
- Reviews literature, accesses publicly available coding systems, and uses LSEG tools to support research projects
- Prepares client deliverables, within designated budget and timeframe, including interpretation of results, reports, technical memoranda, posters, presentations, and manuscripts. Qualifications & Experience:
- Degree or equivalent
- Previous experience in a research related role
- For some roles: Postgraduate / Ph.D. in a quantitative field or equivalent. The role will involve data collection and manipulation, quantitative and qualitative analysis. The candidate will be responsible to develop and maintain models of trade flows, oil production, supply and demand balances and refining. The role is based in Mumbai, India and will focus on covering the Europe, Middle East and Asia region. The candidate will also be expected to develop excel and Power BI models along with power point documents based on our research and datasets. The candidates should demonstrate strong analytical and communication skills and have prior experience in commodities and energy markets. The ideal candidate will be a team player, but, given the nature of the role, should be also capable of working independently and with minimal supervision.

Responsible for maintaining and develop market models Improve content and design of our Workspace-based analytical tools, charts, and tables Communicate market insight in reports and presentations Makes recommendations that may shape operational strategy. Determines the nature of complex or undefined problems; independently identifies the best solution from many alternatives. Escalates higher risk or more unique problems. Decisions require interpretive thinking and some judgment in developing solutions

A bachelor’s degree holder from a reputable university. A masters or technical specialization / certification would be an advantage. Time management skills for managing multiple tasks simultaneously, while completing work within allocated timeframes. Team player, with a flexible attitude and approach. Good critical thinking, Problem-solving and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail. title: Senior Content Analyst
jobDescription: This position is for the role of Senior Content Analyst within Foreign Exchange & Money Market (FX & MM) Pricing team within Realtime Pricing. The role is required to provide 24/5 coverage for maintaining FXMM data on flagship products such as Workspace and Data Scope Suite; responsible for ensuring content set is maintained and delivered in an accurate and timely manner while also supporting prioritized projects. RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for timely availability, accuracy and completeness of meta-data and pricing information in real-time, reference and historical databases for foreign exchange & Money Market instruments. Monitor global market events interpreting impact of the same on our process. Work with various internal teams to identify trends and areas of concern raised by clients with solutions to reduce client queries. Add new content & increase coverage of instruments working on projects. Support specific projects, content testing and responsible for delivering high productivity and quality data. Own complete accountability of process related issues and drive improvement on DCC and process Metrics. Assist in resolving customer cases partnering with service and other client facing teams. Be flexible to work in different shifts (rotational) supporting 24/5 coverage. The process involves monitoring and validating pricing data daily for key Asian, European and North American FI/FX & MM content sets. The team also works on delivery of Content Enhancements. The team needs to ensure to provide flawless support for our content and act as a point of contact for any pricing related queries, client issues on prices and charting etc SCOPE & IMPACT Accountable for the quality of own work, delivered within agreed timeframes and quality standards. Quality of work is reviewed to ensure it is delivered within set parameters of timeliness, accuracy, and completeness. Works independently within defined area, taking ownership of problems within own area of knowledge. TECHNICAL / PROFESSIONAL SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Knowledge of Deming, EVAI, SELF and NDA is added advantages. Basic conceptual knowledge of FXMM and Over the counter (OTC) instruments. Effectively communicate both internally & externally. Should be able to work under pressure. Excellent attention to details, eager to learn new things and multitasking. Knowledge of MS Excel. Bachelor’s degree required. LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. jobDescription: Role Profile The Atlassian JIRA Engineer will be part of the Engineering team An Atlassian Engineer (Jira Engineer) configures, administers, and optimizes Atlassian tools—primarily Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence—to streamline team workflows and improve project management. This position will be accountable for defining solutions on assigned projects for Enterprise Tooling, documenting the solution, and coordinating with Enterprise Architect team in taking the solution through the LSEG governance processes wherever applicable. The Role will have to work with the Enterprise Tooling Product Owner/s to propose solutions to the requirements. This position will need to recommend future Atlassian product Roadmap to align strategically with organization’s Enterprise Tooling Framework. Key Responsibilities Administration & Configuration: Install, configure, and maintain Jira and Confluence, including creating complex workflows, custom fields, screens, and dashboards. Workflow Optimization: Collaborate with stakeholders to map business processes into Atlassian tools and implement workflow automation to reduce manual tasks. System Maintenance: Monitor system performance, perform upgrades, manage user permissions/roles, and ensure the security and reliability of the platform. Integrations & Scripting: Integrate Jira with CI/CD tools (e.g., Bitbucket), chat platforms, and other systems using REST APIs, scripting languages like Groovy, Python, or Java Script. User Support & Documentation: Provide technical support and documentation for users and create documentation for tools and processes. Strong understanding of the reporting Framework Handle L3 support tickets individually with in agreed SLAs. Collaborate with business and functional leads to socialise technology projects and obtain cross functional approvals from Legal, Group Risk, Compliance, LCH Ltd/LCH SA, Candidate Profile / Key Skills Workflow Mastery: Expertise in designing and managing complex workflows, including the use of conditions, validators, and post-functions to enforce business rules. JQL (Jira Query Language): Advanced proficiency in JQL for creating complex filters, reports, and dashboards. Scheme Management: Strong understanding of Jira's architecture, including permission schemes, notification schemes, and issue type screen schemes. Jira Service Management (JSM) & ITSM: Knowledge of IT Service Management processes, including setting up SLAs, automation rules, and customer portals Script Runner & Groovy: Proficiency in Groovy scripting to extend Jira functionality beyond its native out-of-the-box capabilities. API Integration: Deep knowledge of REST APIs for integrating Atlassian tools with other enterprise systems (e.g., Slack, Git Hub, or internal tools). Programming: Foundational skills in Java, Python, or Java Script (specifically Node.js/React for the Atlassian Forge platform) for building custom plugins or apps Agile Proficiency: Solid understanding of Scrum and Kanban frameworks to ensure Jira configurations effectively support development teams. Infrastructure & OS: Familiarity with Linux/Windows environments and relational databases (SQL). Version Control: Competency with Git/Bitbucket to manage CI/CD pipelines and source code integrations Cloud and Saa S Implementation System Integration AI chatbot, LLMs knowledge is preferred. Stakeholder Management Reporting Frameworks Degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent experience Proven training in software development lifecycle or methodologies Soft Skills: Strong Planning, organisational and stakeholder holder management, with confidence to challenge preconceptions of outcomes and solutions. Good communication, presentation, documentation, and customer engagement skills with proven ability to work effectively with all organisational levels. Global experience – working successfully with teams in multiple locations simultaneously. title: Senior Data Engineer - Customer Success
jobDescription:
We’re building the next generation of capital markets technology. Global capital markets generate an ocean of fastmoving, interconnected, and highly complex data—and we’re on a mission to make sense of it. Our teams are passionate problem‑ solvers‑ dedicated to capturing, storing, and transforming the world’s market data. If you thrive in data-driven environments and want to help power the technology behind the world’s leading financial institutions, we’d‑ love to meet you. Role Overview As a Senior Data Engineer
- Customer Success, you will support global financial firms by diagnosing, resolving, and escalating technical issues across our data pipelines. You will work closely with clients and cross-functional‑ engineering teams to ensure the reliability and performance of large‑scale, automated data flows. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, operations, and client support—ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges in a high-impact‑ environment What You’ll Do Provide technical support for data ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to batch processing, automation, and data job failures. Collaborate with other engineering teams to improve pipeline stability and performance. Manage and monitor processing workflows and job schedules. Support clients by analyzing incidents, identifying root causes, and driving resolutions or escalations. Required Qualifications Strong experience with Python, including writing and maintaining object-oriented‑ applications. Hands-‑on experience with job scheduling and workflow tools such as Jenkins, Rundeck, Apache Airflow, or similar. Background working in batch data processing or large‑scale automated data environments. Experience with ETL pipelines and Data Lake architectures. Proficiency with Git version control (Git Lab or Git Hub). Strong command of Linux, including server operations, system processes, daemons, and task scheduling. Comfortable with data movement operations and large‑scale automation. Ability to work US shift: 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST. Nice to Have Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS Redshift, Athena, Dremio, or Snowflake. title: Senior Manager, Employee Listening
jobDescription: Role Purpose We're looking for a strategic employee listening leader to define and evolve how LSEG understands employee experience. This role will be responsible for shaping our employee listening strategy, leading key programmes such as engagement surveys, & qualitative listening and ensuring employee feedback translates into meaningful action. They will help us move beyond measuring employee sentiment to understanding what drives it and what leaders need to do differently as a result. Working closely with People Insights, people partners (BPPs/Country) and senior stakeholders across the business, they will build a trusted, evidence-based approach to employee listening that balances employee voice, business priorities and measurable impact. What you'll do Define and evolve our employee listening strategy Evolve and lead a clear employee listening strategy aligned to LSEG's people and business priorities. Ensure listening activities deliver meaningful insight while avoiding unnecessary survey fatigue. Bring external thinking and best practice on employee experience and listening into the organisation. Find opportunities to modernise how we listen to employees, including new technologies, AI-enabled capabilities and emerging approaches. Lead enterprise listening programmes Own the strategy and delivery of enterprise listening activities, including engagement surveys and targeted listening exercises. Ensure surveys and feedback mechanisms are purposeful, well-designed and generate actionable insight. Establish governance, standards and guidelines for listening across the organisation. Manage relationships with listening platform providers and external partners. Turn employee voice into business insight Translate employee feedback into clear, compelling insights for leaders. Identify key themes, risks and opportunities impacting employee experience and organisational effectiveness. Partner with People Insights and Data Science teams to connect listening data with broader workforce trends where relevant. Create executive-ready narratives that help leaders focus on what matters most. Drive action and impact Help leaders move from insight to action. Design practical approaches to action planning and follow-through. Measure the impact of actions taken and continuously improve our listening approach based on outcomes. Build confidence across the organisation that employee feedback is being heard and acted upon. Build capability and influence leaders Act as LSEG's subject matter expert on employee listening and employee experience measurement. Coach People Function teams and leaders on interpreting and using employee feedback effectively. Influence senior stakeholders through data-driven recommendations and clear storytelling. Represent Employee Listening within the wider People Insights strategy. Skills and Experience Essential Significant experience leading employee listening, employee experience, engagement or people insights programmes in a complex organisation. Experience designing and delivering large-scale employee surveys and listening initiatives. Strong ability to translate data into clear, actionable business insights. Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills. Experience presenting findings and recommendations to senior leaders. Strong understanding of employee engagement, organisational culture and employee experience. Ability to balance analytical rigour with practical business decision-making. Preferred / Advantageous Experience working with platforms such as Glint, Qualtrics, Perceptyx, Culture Amp or similar. Experience connecting employee listening data with broader workforce analytics. Knowledge of survey methodology, organisational psychology or behavioural science. Experience using AI and advanced analytics to support employee listening and insight generation. Experience operating in a large global organisation. Experience preparing insights for Executive Committee or Board-level discussions. Design and build reusable data platform capabilities that enable delivery of governed, trusted and discoverable data products at enterprise scale. Improve data quality, lineage, metadata management and governance across the platform. Enable governed, self-service access to operational data for downstream consumers while minimizing data duplication and silos. Partner with teams across observability, incident management, software change management and other domains to understand data requirements and deliver platform capabilities. Design and implement data lifecycle management capabilities including historical tracking, auditability, traceability and data retention strategies. Contribute to platform architecture, engineering standards, reliability and operational excellence. Mentor engineers and contribute to the growth of data engineering and platform engineering capabilities across the team. Required experience and skill must include: 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering or large-scale software engineering. Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, including lineage, governance, metadata management, temporal data modelling, data quality and historical data management. Experience designing, building and operating scalable data platforms and data pipelines. Strong Python programming skills and experience building data-intensive applications, services and frameworks. Advanced SQL expertise, including performance tuning and optimization of analytical workloads. Strong understanding of modern ETL/ELT architectures and data product design principles. Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, CI/CD, automated testing and operational excellence. Experience driving technical architecture discussions and influencing senior stakeholders. Experience leveraging modern developer productivity tools, including Git Hub Copilot, Claude, Codex or similar toolchains. Excellent problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills. Desired experience and skills may have: Experience working with Service Now, CMDB and ITSM datasets. Experience with Apache Iceberg, Snowflake and/or Click House. Experience building applications in AWS and/or Azure environments. Experience implementing data governance, metadata management, lineage or data catalog capabilities. Experience enabling self-service data consumption and data-sharing patterns at enterprise scale. Experience working with Git Hub, Git Lab and modern CI/CD workflows. Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership across teams. We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25. title: Senior Data Scientist
jobDescription:
The Emerging Tech Standard Delivery Team drives the adoption of advanced technologies and develops enterprise‑ready solutions for D&A Operations. In this role, the individual partners with Operations and Technology teams to design data‑driven solutions that deliver clear business and customer value. The position requires strong expertise in data analytics, NLP, deep learning, and data communication, along with the ability to learn financial content and core D&A business processes. The individual must stay current with emerging technologies and collaborate closely with operations groups and specialized machine learning teams to deliver scalable, high‑impact solutions. Role, Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities: Own the product vision for an industry‑leading data management framework, covering data acquisition, cleaning, transformation, and related workflows. Support Lead Data Scientist on end-to-end AI/ML lifecycle: problem definition, design, experimentation, deployment, and continuous improvement. Define an optimized user experience for financial analytics data pipelines, unifying multiple tools and services into an integrated workflow. Partner with analytics domain experts to understand business data needs and translate them into a practical platform and framework strategy. Lead the execution of this strategy in close collaboration with engineering and project delivery teams. Communicate product goals, progress, and achievements to product, engineering, business leaders, sales, proposition, support, and other internal stakeholders. Stay informed on financial analytics market trends to maintain a forward‑looking, future‑ready strategy. Continuously learn and adapt to emerging technologies and techniques in financial analytics. Develop and deploy production‑grade AI models and data‑driven solutions aligned with strategic objectives. Tune and optimize AI models to improve accuracy, performance, and scalability. Evaluate third‑party AI capabilities using both functional and non‑functional criteria. Establish and enforce coding standards to ensure a maintainable, robust codebase. Collaborate with Software Engineers and cross‑functional teams to define requirements, set direction, and shape development roadmaps. Hands‑on experience in data science, including Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG). Skilled in training, testing, and validating deep learning models as well as classical machine learning models. Ability to design and implement evaluation frameworks for automation solutions based on business requirements. Experience building solutions and onboarding workloads on AWS or other cloud platforms. Expertise in web crawling and scraping techniques, entity identification and extraction, and advanced pre‑ and post‑processing methods using emerging technologies such as prompt engineering. Proficient in processing structured, semi‑structured, and unstructured data from PDFs and scanned documents. Required Skills: · 6–8 years of experience in data science, analytics, or statistical modelling roles. · Strong foundation in data analytics, feature engineering, NLP, predictive modelling, LLMs, and RAG workflows. · Expertise in Python and core ML/DL libraries (Tensor Flow, Py Torch, Scikit‑learn), with demonstrated experience in developing and productionizing AI models. · Proven ability to apply strong statistical analysis skills, including probability and applied statistics, to model development and evaluation. · Experience with Git‑based version control and CI/CD pipelines (Git Lab/Git Hub runners). · Strong understanding of relational databases, large‑scale data processing, and statistical programming. · Familiarity with MLOps principles and experience deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure). · Hands‑on experience with commercial or open‑source data management tools. · Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of simplifying complex technical concepts for both technical and business audiences. · Strong influencing and collaboration skills, supporting cross‑team execution and alignment. · Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical and business problems using deep analytical and industry knowledge · Ability to set and uphold coding standards. · Hands-on experience with leading commercial or open-source data management tools. · Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to present to peers, senior management, and cross-functional partners. · Broad business awareness and understanding of relevant internal business relationships. Preferred Experience in large financial services or investment banking environments. Familiarity with Refinitiv or LSEG products and financial data workflows. Experience working with global or distributed teams. Comfort interacting with senior stakeholders, including executives and C‑suite partners.

EDUCATION:
· Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, or Computer Science with a Data Science certification, or an Engineering degree specializing in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. · Proficiency in Python, R, and SQL. title: Research Analyst
jobDescription: Research Analyst, KYC Operations Position Summary This role is within our Group Anti Financial Crime Utility team, specializing in Know Your Client (KYC) and Anti Money Laundering. The KYC Operations function is specialist in, but not limited to, onboarding and customer risk assessments generating MI reports, SLA and critical metric execution, quality control and quality assurance execution. KYC Operations will also be responsible for Operational training design and delivery. Roles and Responsibilities Conduct KYC onboarding and periodic reviews through comprehensive data collection and analysis. Follows SOP and procedures to ensure KYC is performed in an accurate and timely manner. Raising unresolved queries to the next level of support and ensures accurate recording, documentation, and closure of alerts. Review all trigger events related to existing clients, where required gather additional supporting documentation. Undertake AML and sanction/PEP screening, on-boarding due diligence checks and ongoing monitoring ensuring that consistent processes are followed in line with global strategy and requirements. Ensure sanction/PEP screening are conducted and accurate course of action is taken. Carry out complex research/investigations to confirm whether the potential matches to global sanctions lists are actual matches according to laid down guidelines. title: Development Team Lead(.NET)
jobDescription: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG. OUR PEOPLE: People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers. Position Overview The Development Team Lead (.NET) is responsible for providing hands‑on technical leadership, mentoring, and delivery oversight for a team building enterprise applications on the Microsoft .NET platform. This role blends deep .NET expertise with people leadership, Agile delivery, and cross‑functional collaboration. The Team Lead works closely with Product, QA, Dev Ops, Architecture, and Delivery to ensure consistent, predictable, and high‑quality delivery. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership Lead the design and development of applications using C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, LINQ, and related .NET technologies. Guide modernization of legacy VB.NET applications into C# or .NET Core where appropriate. Perform and enforce high‑quality code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards, clean architecture, and SOLID principles. Break down complex technical requirements into well‑scoped stories and tasks. Work with Architects to align on technical patterns, integration approaches, and long‑term platform direction. People Leadership & Coaching Provide day‑to‑day support, mentorship, and coaching to developers across varying experience levels. Foster a positive, inclusive culture centered on learning, ownership, and accountability. Conduct regular 1:1s and support career development, skills progression, and performance management. Agile Delivery & Planning Lead sprint planning, backlog readiness, estimation, and throughput optimization. Facilitate daily stand‑ups, reviews, and retrospectives; remove team impediments rapidly. Coordinate dependencies with QA, Dev Ops, and other teams; ensure release readiness and change control. Partner with the Delivery Manager (or act in that capacity where needed) to maintain predictable sprint throughput and reliable release timelines. Quality & Reliability Ensure strong testing practices: unit testing (x Unit/NUnit/MSTest), integration testing, API testing, and automation support and high code coverage targets. Collaborate with QA to embed quality in the workflow; drive shift‑left testing practices. Validate that applications meet non‑functional requirements such as performance, resilience, and security. Collaborate with Dev Ops to improve CI/CD pipelines, environment stability, and release automation. System & Application Ownership Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across environments (DEV/QA/UAT/PROD). Lead root cause analysis for production incidents and identify long‑term fixes. Monitor application health using Application Insights, logging frameworks, and dashboards. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner with Product Owners to refine user stories, clarify requirements, and provide estimates. Work closely with Dev Ops for CI/CD enhancements and infrastructure needs (Azure preferred). Collaborate with QA Lead, Architecture, and Security teams to ensure compliance with standards. Qualifications Required 6+ years of professional software development experience with .NET Framework and .NET Core. 2+ years in a people leader role. Strong expertise in C#, with working knowledge of VB.NET (maintenance, migration, or modernization). Experience building REST APIs, microservices, or modular applications using ASP.NET Core/Web API. Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines (Azure Dev Ops/Git Hub Actions), unit testing frameworks, and design patterns. Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban) with strong facilitation skills. Demonstrated ability to lead teams, influence architecture, and deliver complex initiatives. title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET)
jobDescription: Position Overview The Senior Software Engineer (.NET) is a technical leader responsible for designing, building, and optimizing modern, cloud‑ready applications using the latest Microsoft .NET technologies. This role focuses on scalable architectures, high‑quality code, Dev Ops‑driven delivery, and best‑in‑class engineering practices. The Senior Engineer collaborates closely with Product, QA, Dev Ops, and Delivery teams to deliver robust solutions, influence architectural direction, mentor engineers, and champion continuous improvement across the full development lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Modern Application Architecture & Development Architect, develop, and maintain applications using .NET 6+, C#, ASP.NET Core, and modern frameworks. Build and enhance RESTful APIs, microservices, messaging components, and background workers. Lead modernization efforts by refactoring or migrating legacy VB.NET and older .NET Framework applications to modern .NET. Apply engineering best practices including SOLID principles, domain‑driven design (DDD), dependency injection, asynchronous programming, and clean architecture patterns. Write secure, testable, performant code and drive engineering excellence across the team. Technical Leadership Lead complex development initiatives with autonomy and technical ownership. Guide the team on system architecture, code quality, performance optimization, and maintainability. Conduct in‑depth code reviews and mentor developers to elevate technical capabilities. Anticipate technical risks and provide mitigation strategies during planning and design phases. Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner with Product Managers to clarify requirements, roadmap impacts, and technical feasibility. Collaborate with QA to enhance automated testing, shift‑left quality practices, and overall reliability. Work with Dev Ops to optimize CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud readiness. Support Delivery Management by identifying risks, dependencies, and technical constraints early. Database & Integration Engineering Design, implement, and optimize relational database structures using SQL Server, with a strong focus on stored procedures, views, indexing strategies, and query performance. Develop high‑performance T‑SQL code, including complex stored procedures, functions, triggers, and optimized queries for large datasets. Perform database performance tuning, index analysis, query plan evaluation, and workload optimization to ensure scalability and reliability. Integrate applications with internal and external systems using REST APIs, event streams, message queues, file‑based exchanges, or service bus technologies. Collaborate with DBAs and architects on capacity planning, schema design, data governance, and best practices for secure data access. Performance, Observability & Security Perform performance profiling, memory optimization, and load testing. Implement secure coding practices aligned with OWASP guidance and least‑privilege standards. Build resilient, observable systems with structured logging (Serilog/ELK), metrics, distributed tracing, and robust error handling. Mentorship & Continuous Improvement Mentor junior and intermediate developers through pairing, coaching, and knowledge-sharing. Influence and contribute to internal frameworks, shared libraries, and engineering standards. Advocate for continuous improvement in development flow, automation, tooling, and Dev Ops maturity. Help foster a learning culture through documentation, workshops, and code craftsmanship. Skills & Qualifications Required 5+ years of professional experience developing applications with the modern .NET ecosystem. Strong expertise in C# and hands‑on experience with modern .NET (6+), ASP.NET Core, Web API, LINQ, and object-oriented design. Experience maintaining or migrating legacy VB.NET or .NET Framework applications. Hands-on experience building and consuming REST APIs and working in microservices, modular, or distributed architectures. Strong SQL Server knowledge, including data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning. Proficiency with Git, CI/CD pipelines (Azure Dev Ops/Git Hub Actions), and automated deployment workflows. Experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments. Preferred Experience with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure (App Services, Azure Functions, Key Vault, Storage, Service Bus, etc.). Experience with Docker, containers, and Kubernetes/AKS. Knowledge of DDD, event-driven architecture, messaging patterns (e.g., Service Bus, Kafka). Exposure to front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Blazor) is an asset. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field—or equivalent practical experience. If you are creative and a problem solver, this is the place to be as will be supporting you to fast-forward your career! title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobDescription:
ROLE SUMMARY: We are hiring a Site Reliability Engineer to help us run and improve LSEG's internal observability platform
- and we want you to be part of building something that matters! Our platform brings telemetry, dashboards, alerts, service health, and operational insight into one common experience. We use it to help engineering and service teams detect issues earlier, reduce incident impact, and improve operational reliability. The focus of this role is the platform itself
- its reliability, supportability, and usability
- and the standards and self-service patterns that help teams adopt it consistently. This is not a general application monitoring role; ownership of dashboards, alerts, or telemetry for every application team is not what we are looking for here. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Platform operations and reliability:
- Monitor platform health, investigate and diagnose issues, and support service recovery across production and non-production environments.
- Contribute to service readiness through dashboards, SLOs, SLIs, runbooks, resilience checks, and performance validation.
- Use metrics, logs, traces, and service health data to understand issues and guide practical decisions. Incident response and continuous improvement:
- Support incident response, triage, problem management, and root cause analysis.
- Drive follow-up actions that reduce repeat issues and improve operational consistency.
- Improve automation and Git Ops-based workflows to reduce manual work across the team. Enablement and documentation:
- Maintain documentation, onboarding guides, and self-service tooling so teams can operate with less reliance on direct support.
- Provide direct enablement on telemetry standards, alerting guidance, SLO practices, and platform workflows. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Essential skills and experience:
- Experience supporting production platforms or services in an SRE, platform engineering, infrastructure, Dev Ops, or operations engineering role.
- Experience using observability data such as metrics, logs, traces, alerts, dashboards, or service health views to investigate issues.
- Understanding of incident response, problem management, service readiness, or operational support processes.
- Experience using automation or infrastructure-as-code practices to support repeatable delivery and operations.
- Solid understanding of cloud, container, Linux, networking, or distributed system environments.
- Ability to communicate technical information clearly to engineering, operations, and service stakeholders.
- Experience writing or maintaining operational documentation such as runbooks, support guides, or onboarding material.
- A practical approach to improving reliability, reducing manual work, and helping teams use shared platforms optimally. Desirable skills and experience:
- Experience with observability, monitoring, telemetry, or data pipeline technologies such as Open Telemetry, Grafana, Click House, Cribl, Datadog, Big Panda, Redis, Flink, or similar tools.
- Experience with Git Ops workflows and tools such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, pull requests, environment promotion, or configuration-as-code.
- Experience building or supporting internal platforms used by multiple engineering teams.
- Experience defining or using SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, alert quality measures, or service health models.
- Experience supporting telemetry pipelines, data routing, data filtering, retention, or cost management.
- Experience working in a regulated, financial services, or large enterprise technology environment.
- Experience helping engineering teams adopt shared standards, templates, or self-service platform capabilities. title: Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: Our Team We are evolving our Reliability Engineering team to move beyond support and operations. As a Senior Engineer in Site Reliability, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive organization that has full ownership of the availability, performance, and scalability of one of the most critical shared services at LSEG. We are looking for people with a passion for learning and a continuous improvement mindset to join our Electronic Trading (ET) team. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, reliability, and operational excellence of our high- performance FX trading platform technology used by major financial institutions around the world. This role plays a key part in ensuring our trading systems remain robust, secure, scalable, and highly available. You will work across complex, mission critical environments and drive architectural enhancements that support the future of our platform. The ET platform is a highly configurable, component-based FX dealing system delivered as isolated client instances. It supports direct electronic trading via web interfaces, connectivity adaptors, and APIs. The platform integrates seamlessly with market rate providers, credit engines, and backend services to enable full straight through processing. What You Will Do Own and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for the systems you support. Continuously measure and improve availability, and overall system health. Develop automation to scale systems sustainably and prevent or mitigate service issues. Partner with development teams to enhance reliability, observability, and release velocity. Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, post incident reviews, and root cause analysis. Promote strong engineering practices to help build, deploy, and operate high performance services. Act as a key enabler for Cloud migration, working with operations and engineering teams from project inception through to operational readiness. Conduct architectural reviews, support operational acceptance testing, and configure Datadog dashboards and metrics. You will need to have experience of Dev Ops or operating highly available distributed systems, strong scripting and automation skills (Bash,Python,etc). Understanding of Linux and cloud environments. Knowledge of working with financial trading systems an advantage. Minimum qualifications A bachelor's degree in computer science, a related technical field involving software/systems engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Experience with programming languages such as: Java, C#, Python. Experience with relational databases and SQL Experience with Infrastructure as Code.
