title: Third Party Risk Manager
jobDescription:
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years! Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG. Job Details Job Posting Title: Third-Party Risk Management Manager Justification: New Role Job Profile: Manager, Non-financial Risk The Role We are hiring for a Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Manager to join the LSEG Risk Intelligence (RI) Division. This is a dynamic role requiring an individual to support delivery of the RI division TPRM commitments as well strong governance and stakeholder management. The role reports to the Head of the RI Risk and Controls team. Key Responsibilities Governance Help mature the RI’s TPRM risk lifecycle—covering due diligence, onboarding, ongoing monitoring, issue management, and exit—so that third‑party services are resilient, compliant, secure, and aligned to business objectives. The role drives a risk‑based, data‑driven programme across critical suppliers and outsourced arrangements, partnering with Procurement, Legal, Security, Privacy, and the Business as required. Support the RI TPRM framework, policy, standards, and procedures; ensure alignment with the enterprise risk management framework (ERMF). Maintain risk taxonomy and tiering methodology for vendors (e.g., criticality, data sensitivity, concentration). Help define and track KRIs/KPIs; drive continuous improvement and audit‑readiness. Help ensure the RI TPRM frameworks are in line with regulatory requirements (e.g. DORA, FCA’s Operational Resilience framework, Australia’s CPS 230 Prudential standard). Help ensure the organisation meets all the LSEG TPRM policy divisional requirements. Help develop and manage risk management programs, including scenario testing and stress-testing exercises as required. Risk Assessment Oversee inherent risk scoping and third‑party segmentation. Ensure proportional controls and risk treatment plans aligned to risk appetite. Regulatory Knowledge & Compliance: Help ensure the RI division is aware of and adhering to all required regulations and controls. Support the preparation for audits and regulatory inspections, ensuring that all required documentation and evidence are prepared in advance. Senior Management Communication: Present key TPRM updates to the RI Risk Committee, and to associated Group driven governance forums ensuring they understand potential risks and mitigation strategies. Provide thought leadership and strategic insights on TPRM to senior management. Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams (e.g., IT, legal, compliance) to ensure all aspects of TPRM are being effectively handled. Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for improvement and champion projects to enhance the organisation's overall TPRM posture. Support the development and delivery of training programs to increase awareness of TPRM requirements across the organisation. Skills and Experience Required: TPRM Experience: Strong background in TPRM. Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as DORA, FCA’s operational resilience agenda, and SOC2 compliance desirable. Experience in defining and implementing TPRM controls, key performance indicators, and key control indicators (KCIs) to measure effectiveness and mitigate risks. Senior-Level Communication & Presentation Skills: Experience presenting complex TPRM data to senior stakeholders in a clear, actionable manner. Ability to influence senior leaders on risk-related decisions and TPRM improvements. Strong report-writing skills to deliver structured and impactful presentations. Scenario Testing & Stress-Testing: Experience in conducting scenario testing and stress-testing exercises, assessing the impact of various risk events on business functions. Key Competencies: Analytical Thinking: Strong ability to analyse TPRM risks and identify solutions that balance resilience with efficiency. Problem-Solving: Ability to think creatively and address complex challenges. Collaboration: Ability to work across teams and divisions and influence colleagues at all levels to improve TPRM risk management processes. Attention to Detail: Strong focus on accuracy and thoroughness when designing controls and assessing risks. Programme Management: Able to plan and execute effectively. Relationship building and stakeholders management skills. Process and detail oriented. Demonstrated ability to take initiative and drive projects to completion. Ability to adapt to change and multi-task in a dynamic environment. Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Able to work effective on their own or as part of a team. Experience Ideal candidate will have a 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following Risk areas
- TPRM / Operational Risk Management / Non-Financial Risk Management. Qualifications Ideal candidate will have a minimum of degree level qualification and/or relevant professional qualifications/experience and worked in the financial services sector and have some experience in risk/compliance/audit. Desired Skills and Personal Attributes Analytical thinking Relationship building and stakeholders management skills Process and detail oriented Demonstrated ability to take initiative and drive projects to completion. Ability to adapt to change and multi-task in a dynamic environment. Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point and Access) required Able to work effective on their own or as part of a team. title: Senior Engineer - Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Risk Intelligence Role summary As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you’ll help build and run reliable, secure, and performant cloud services that our customers depend on. You’ll shape how we define and measure reliability (for example through Service Level Objectives), improve automation in our delivery pipelines, and use infrastructure-as-code to make our platforms easier to operate and scale. We welcome applicants from a range of backgrounds—including SRE, Dev Ops, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Software Engineering with strong operations experience. On-call: You’ll take part in a 24x7 team on-call rotation. From time to time, this may include planned out-of-hours maintenance to support a highly available service. We aim to share the load fairly, invest in automation to reduce toil, and continuously improve the on-call experience. Key responsibilities Define, agree, and monitor Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for critical user journeys and cloud components (for example: EKS, Document DB, RDS/My SQL, and API Gateway). Design and extend observability using tools such as Datadog and AWS Cloud Watch so teams can detect issues early and diagnose them quickly. Lead incident response and drive root-cause analysis and remediation, following change control practices that meet LSEG and client expectations. Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Support, and leadership to balance reliability, feature delivery, and customer impact. Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, and procedures as services evolve. Coach and mentor other engineers, helping to embed reliability practices across the team. What you’ll bring Relevant experience in SRE, Dev Ops, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related role (or equivalent practical experience). Experience automating infrastructure and delivery workflows—such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines (for example, Git Lab CI/CD). Working knowledge of AWS and common services used to build and operate production systems (for example: Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, Document DB, RDS/My SQL, and Cloud Watch/Cloud Watch Insights). Comfort working across Linux and/or Windows environments. Experience with Kubernetes (including managed services such as Amazon EKS). Ability to script to automate and troubleshoot (for example, Python and/or Java Script). Experience building actionable monitoring, alerting, and dashboards (for example, Datadog and Cloud Watch). Clear communication, curiosity, and a collaborative approach—especially during incidents and post-incident reviews. Good to have Skills: Experience operating Kubernetes clusters beyond day-to-day use (upgrades, capacity planning, networking, security). Software engineering experience in Python and/or Java Script beyond scripting (testing, packaging, code reviews). Experience improving observability practices at scale (for example: metric design, alert tuning, incident analytics). ROLE PROFILE: As part of our engineering team, you will design, build, and improve backend services using C# and .NET technologies within AWS-based cloud environment. You will work independently while collaborating with peers to improve system performance, reliability, and engineering practices across the team. RESPONSIBILITIES:
Follow best practices and QA methodologies and processes, working across critical stages of the product lifecycle from define to build Understand the business use cases and carry out testing to ensure top quality of delivered solutions Understand and analyse the Requirement Specifications and design test scenarios Review and analyse completeness of test coverage Carry out Functional testing and Non-functional testing Solve technical issues and challenges in testing work Execute Test Scripts, Defect tracking in applicable tool, Status Reporting, Defect Reporting Drive continuous improvement from quality perspective Responsible for communicating the status of ongoing work to stakeholders accurately About you: Proven experience as a Quality Engineer (Manual & Automation) Demonstratable experience in QA methodologies Familiarity with all types of testing viz functional, integration, regression, smoke/sanity, acceptance, system testing, non-functional: performance, scalability, load and soak Good written and interpersonal communication skills and ability to effectively communicate across cross functional teams Excellent communication and collaboration skills Analytical and problem-solving skills Experience required: 2-4 years in Quality Engineer role Proficiency in building and maintaining automation frameworks using Python/pytest (preferred) or Java. Solid experience with UI automation tools (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) and API/service automation (REST Assured, Karate, Postman, etc.). Experience validating microservices and distributed systems in enterprise environments. Working knowledge of Azure Cloud services and deployments (preferred). Experience integrating automation suites into CI/CD pipelines (Azure Dev Ops preferred). Experience on SQL query with RDBMS (Postgre SQL) Experience with Jira, Confluence and Test Rail Demonstrated ability to apply AI/ML techniques across the test lifecycle, such as test case generation, defect prediction, test data creation, and automation optimization. Strong understanding of Agile, shift-left testing practices, and quality engineering principles. Excellent communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork.

title: Snr Engineering Manager(Dotnet with Azure)
jobDescription: Why this role We’re building Risk Intelligence products that help customers make trusted decisions in real time. You will take products from 0→1 and 1→n, keeping the customer and product at the center, and own the outcome from discovery and MVP through scaled, reliable operations. You’ll lead by doing with your team, choose the best technology for the job, and create a culture of learning, psychological safety, and excellence. Note: Our current ecosystem includes Azure and .NET among other technologies, but we evaluate and adopt the most appropriate stack for each product/customer outcome and evolve it over time. What you’ll do **Build complete products, 0→1:** Partner with Product/Design to validate problems, shape hypotheses, define MVP scope, and ship v1 quickly. Instrument time‑to‑first‑value (TTFV), learn from usage, and iterate to product‑market fit. **Scale 1→n with reliability:** Grow v1 into resilient, observable, cost‑aware services with clear SLOs, strong incident readiness, and blameless post‑incident learning loops. **Lead by doing (player/coach):** Join critical design sessions, pair when it helps, and review high‑risk PRs while developing engineers via clarity, feedback, and opportunities. **Own live‑site:** Establish pragmatic on‑call practices and a healthy live‑site culture; drive continuous improvement from real production signals. **Engineer for outcomes, not tools:** Guide architecture and platform choices (APIs, domain boundaries, data modeling, eventing, UI) with explicit tradeoffs; evaluate build‑vs‑buy and manage cost/performance/security with measurable impact. **Drive innovation:** Spark lightweight tech spikes and design/experiment workshops; create space for well‑scoped bets that de‑risk the roadmap and unlock step‑changes for customers (learning delivered over slideware). **Build an inclusive, high‑performing team:** Hire well, run effective 1:1s, create psychological safety, and establish growth paths for engineers and tech leads. **Collaborate across the business:** Partner with Risk Intelligence stakeholders to integrate services and meet regulatory/security expectations while simplifying the customer experience. What you’ll bring 8–10+ years in software engineering with 2–4+ years leading teams; shipped and operated customer‑facing services at meaningful scale. Demonstrated 0→1 track record: turning ambiguous problems into MVPs and iterating into durable, scalable solutions with customers. Ability to learn/adapt quickly and pick the right tool—language, framework, or cloud service—based on outcome, operability, and time‑to‑value; willingness to retire tech that no longer serves us. Excellence in communication and stakeholder partnership; comfortable making—and explaining—tradeoffs under time and risk. How we’ll measure success Product outcomes: time‑to‑first‑value (TTFV), adoption/retention of new capabilities, and customer feedback informing roadmap. Software delivery (DORA): improved change lead time and deployment frequency; better failed deployment recovery time and lower change failure rate. Reliability & quality: SLO attainment, incident and defect trends, and strong observability signals across services. Team health: hiring quality/velocity, growth & retention, engagement, and a strong TL/EM bench. Technologies you and the team may use Backends & APIs: .NET/Java/Go/Node (expert in at least 1), REST/g RPC, event‑driven patterns Frontends: Web (React/Next), design systems, accessibility Cloud & Platform: Azure/AWS, container orchestration, CI/CD, Ia C, secrets & identity Data & Observability: relational/No SQL, streaming, metrics/logs/traces, cost telemetry We select and evolve the stack based on customer value, operability, and time‑to‑impact—not allegiance to any single technology. Ways of working Hybrid collaboration with intentional in‑person time for planning/design sprints and post‑incident reviews, while supporting deep work wherever you’re most effective. Manager Operating Principles (what great looks like) Customer & product at the center: We measure success by user outcomes—not just shipped code. Extreme ownership: We build it, ship it, run it—end‑to‑end. Lead by doing: We roll up our sleeves on the moments that matter and raise the bar every day. Outcome‑driven technology: We pick tools for outcomes and change course when the data says so. Learn fast, improve continuously: We use DORA, SLOs, and customer feedback to decide what to fix, build, and stop. Our culture & benefits Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies, and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. We offer formal and informal learning, paid volunteering days, and a strong commitment to inclusion and equal opportunity—with reasonable accommodations throughout hiring and employment. Benefits We are looking for intellectually curious people, passionate about the bigger picture of how technology industry is evolving, ready to ask difficult questions and deal with complicated scenarios! If you are creative and a problem solver, this is the place to be as will be supporting you to fast-forward your career! We enhance each employee’s potential through personal development through a wide range of learning tools both formal and informal. title: Evaluator, Sovereign and Corporate Bonds
jobDescription: Summary: The Evaluator for Sovereign and Corporate Bonds is responsible for providing timely and accurate end-of-day evaluations on fixed income securities for LSEG Pricing Service. LSEG Pricing Service evaluations are used by banks, asset managers, index managers, wealth managers, and auditors for client statements, research, risk analysis, performance metrics, and portfolio valuation. LSEG Pricing Service provides evaluations on over 3MM securities and derivatives daily. Role Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities: • Determine the fair market value for government and corporate bonds in Asian currencies, in particular for India market. • Aggregate and assess appropriate market color to be used in determining fair market value (trades, quotes, contributions), as well as pro-actively drive methodology / automation enhancement to improve coverage and pricing accuracy. • Utilize technical and financial knowledge to improve coverage, accuracy, and timeliness of prices. • Respond to price challenges in a timely manner with explanations of detailed pricing methodology. • Work with bond desk to improve the customer experience. • Document work procedures and methodology enhancements when needed. • Work with various internal teams for content enhancements. • Explain pricing methodologies to customers – both high level and individual security analysis. title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobDescription:
Role Overview: We are looking for a strong, hands-on, versatile, and highly autonomous Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and operate our enterprise People Function Capability Layer. Working within a lean, high-impact team alongside Data Engineers, you will play a dual

ROLE:
extending backend integration services and enabling data visibility and interaction for business stakeholders. You will be responsible for designing, implementing APIs and building low-code, persona-centric user interfaces (e.g., using Retool) to surface insights and workflows. You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence, data security, and business continuity in a cloud-native environment. We are seeking someone with strong experience in full-stack development and enterprise application engineering, with a focus on Golang/Python, AWS, Java Script/Type Script, Retool, HTML5, and CSS. The candidate will contribute across design, development, deployment, and lifecycle management of applications and services. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, develop, and secure low-latency, scalable RESTful APIs using Golang. Actively contribute to backend service development, supporting event-driven microservices and integration patterns in collaboration with Data Engineers. Develop optimized queries, aggregation logic, and transformation layers to integrate data across relational and No SQL systems. Design, build, and maintain high-value internal applications tailored to different user personas and workflow needs. Define and enforce technical standards, design patterns, and best practices across development, security, and application architecture. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient and reliable software delivery. Drive observability practices using tools such as Datadog and Grafana to monitor application and infrastructure health. Collaborate with distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable, user-centric solutions delivered on time. Design and manage AWS infrastructure to support highly available, low-latency application workloads. Must Have Skills: Strong hands-on experience with Golang/Python for backend development and Java Script/Type Script for frontend development, with solid proficiency in HTML5 and CSS for building responsive, user-centric interfaces. Strong experience in API lifecycle management, including schema design, versioning, throttling and payload optimization. Proficiency in Angular for building responsive, scalable front-end applications as part of a full stack development environment. Deep understanding of SOLID principles, dependency injection, and robust error handling patterns. Strong hands-on experience with AWS services – AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, EC2, S3, RDS, API Gateway, VPC, EKS, ECS, IAM, Cloud Watch and cloud-native application design. Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgre SQL, MS SQL) and No SQL databases (e.g., Dynamo DB). Strong hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers (e.g., Kafka, Rabbit MQ). Hands-on experience building distributed systems on AWS and containerization using Docker. Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git Lab CI). Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, or equivalent. Strong understanding of cloud security best practices including IAM, encryption, vulnerability management, and compliance controls.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of full-stack or software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in full stack development. 3+ years of hands-on experience building full-stack applications, including backend development (Golang/Python, APIs, microservices) and frontend development using Java Script/Type Script frameworks, with strong experience integrating UI layers (e.g., Retool or similar low-code platforms) with distributed, event-driven systems on AWS and Kafka. Nice to have: (Review Certifications) AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, AWS Certified Developer, or equivalent. title: Senior Data Engineer
jobDescription:
Role Overview: We are looking for a strong, hands-on, highly autonomous Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate our enterprise People Function Capability Layer. You will be instrumental in delivering a secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient service layer that integrates multiple systems across the People ecosystem. You will play a critical role in ensuring operational excellence, data integrity, and business continuity in a cloud-native, event-driven environment. We are seeking someone with deep expertise in data engineering, data modelling, and distributed system design, with a focus on Golang, Python, AWS Cloud, and Kafka. The candidate will contribute to the design, development, deployment, and ongoing evolution of our integration and data platforms. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build and lead the development of high-performance, event-driven integration pipelines, applying strong debugging and performance optimization skills to ensure resilient data flows. Define and enforce technical standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices across development, security and data governance. Design and enforce canonical data models and schemas to standardize complex organizational data domains across systems. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to enable reliable, repeatable, and automated software delivery. Drive observability and monitoring using tools such as Datadog and Grafana to ensure system reliability and performance. Collaborate with distributed engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions delivered within agreed timelines. Design, provision, and manage AWS infrastructure to ensure high availability, scalability, and low-latency processing for data workloads. Must Have Skills: Strong hands-on experience in Golang and Python for backend and data engineering use cases. Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services – AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, EC2, S3, RDS, API Gateway, VPC, EKS, ECS, IAM, Cloud Watch and cloud-native architecture patterns. Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgre SQL, MS SQL) and No SQL stores (e.g., Dynamo DB). Strong hands-on experience with message brokers and event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, Rabbit MQ). Hands-on experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and data services. Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git Lab CI). Experience building highly available, distributed systems on AWS, including containerization using Docker. Hands on experience building highly available distributed systems in AWS and containerization using Docker. Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Prometheus, or equivalent. Strong understanding of cloud security best practices including IAM, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and compliance controls.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years focused on data engineering or distributed data platforms. 3+ years of experience working with Golang, Python, AWS, and Kafka in production environments. title: AI Data Engineer
jobDescription:
Role Overview: We are looking for an exceptional AI/Gen AI Data Engineer to join our AI Platform team — one of the most technically ambitious initiatives at LSEG. This is not a role to maintain legacy pipelines. You will design and build the systems that make AI possible at HR-market scale. You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, machine learning infrastructure, and large language model applications. Your work will directly impact products used by the largest financial institutions in the world. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and operate high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines Build and maintain the feature stores, vector databases, and data layers that power production ML models and LLM-based applications across LSEG's product suite Architect SQL and No SQL data systems to serve analytical and operational workloads with strict SLAs, and build real-time event streaming pipelines using Apache Kafka Implement Redis-based caching and pub/sub systems to support sub-millisecond data access for trading and analytics applications Build and deploy machine learning pipelines — from data preprocessing and feature engineering through model training, evaluation, and serving at scale Integrate and fine-tune large language models for different tasks Design and own CI/CD pipelines for data and ML systems, covering automated testing, model validation, and deployment automation Partner with Applied Research, Product Engineering, and Platform teams to translate AI research into reliable, production-grade systems Must Have Skills: LLM & Generative AI: Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications using APIs from Open AI, Anthropic, or similar providers. Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, embedding models, vector stores, and frameworks such as Lang Chain or Llama Index. Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation techniques, and fine-tuning is strongly preferred. MCP (Model Context Protocol): Understanding of MCP primitives for tool invocation, context injection, and secure LLM-to-system interaction. Machine Learning: Solid foundations in supervised and unsupervised machine learning using Scikit-learn, XGBoost, and Py Torch. You should have end-to-end ownership experience — from feature engineering and model training through evaluation, deployment, and production monitoring. Familiarity with MLflow or similar experiment tracking tools and an understanding of model drift detection are expected. Programming — Python & Node.js: Strong Python is essential. You should be comfortable with async programming, writing production-grade APIs with Fast API, data processing with Pandas and Py Spark, and building clean, testable, well-documented code as a default. Node.js with Type Script experience for event-driven backend services is a plus. SQL — Click House, Postgre SQL & Snowflake: Deep hands-on experience with at least two of Click House, Postgre SQL, and Snowflake. You should be confident with complex query writing and optimisation, indexing strategies, partitioning, window functions, and understanding the trade-offs between OLTP and OLAP workloads. Experience with Click House for high-performance analytical queries on time-series financial data is particularly valued. No SQL — Elasticsearch & Redis: Production experience with Elasticsearch for full-text search, aggregations, and log analytics — including index lifecycle management, mapping optimisation, and cluster configuration. Redis experience covering caching patterns, pub/sub messaging, Redis Streams, and session management in high-throughput environments. Streaming — Apache Kafka: Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka for building real-time event streaming pipelines. You should be comfortable with producer/consumer patterns, topic partitioning, consumer group management, and Kafka Connect for data integration. Experience with Kafka Streams or processing financial market events (order flow, price ticks, corporate actions) in a low-latency production environment is a strong advantage. CI/CD: Solid understanding of CI/CD principles with hands-on experience using Git Hub Actions or Jenkins. You should be comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes, and writing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Helm. The expectation is that you treat deployment pipelines as production code — automated testing, rollback strategies, and environment parity are non-negotiable. Cloud — AWS: Primary cloud experience on AWS. You should have working knowledge of core data and compute services — S3, RDS, Redshift, Lambda, ECS/EKS, and Sage Maker. Experience with cost optimisation and multi-region architecture design is a plus.

QUALIFICATIONS:
7+ years of hands-on data engineering or ML engineering experience in production environments Strong system design instincts — you consider failure modes, backpressure, and graceful degradation as first-class concerns You default to observability — metrics, tracing, and alerts are built in before systems go live, not retrofitted after incidents You write the runbook. On-call ownership is something you embrace, not avoid Able to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to product managers, data scientists, and senior stakeholders Experience mentoring junior engineers and conducting meaningful technical code reviews Experience with HR data (time-series, tick data, reference data) is a significant advantage Nice to have: (Review Certifications) Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP Data Engineer) Databricks or Spark-based certification ML / AI certification We're proud to have been recognised as a Great Place to Work® in India ‘25. title: Lead Security Engineer
jobDescription: Are you an Active Directory specialist with a security mentality that loves leading people? Do you want to be integral to lead and maintaining our Privileged user and group accounts within Active Directory (AD) to ensure efficient performance, security, and access control within our organisation! We are looking for a Global Security Access Control (GSAC) Team Lead to lead a shift of skilled specialists, operating a 24/7 service, that involves creating, modifying, deleting Privileged accounts, Security groups as well as managing permissions and access rights, resolving issues, and ensuring compliance with company policies and industry standard methodologies. Role summary: Lead a team to ensure that outstanding service levels are achieved while maintaining internal and customer Service Level Agreements and expectations. You will take accountability for processes, metrics and performance, while supporting tools and process maturity, compliance and quality measurement, training and operation of approved processes. Maintain the GSAC documentation and knowledge bases, serve as an escalation point and be able to resolve the most sophisticated problems independently, providing a high level of client support and conveying resolutions to customer issues Support and facilitate deep dives into process failure within the team to diagnose, treat and resolve them and evaluate standards and processes that the GSAC team is involved with and highlight any areas of improvement. Be a part of a management team that leads the team on a 24/7/365 shift pattern Day to day responsibilities include: Collaborate in a cohesive management team, covering shifts to deliver an exceptional 24/7/365 function Management of the overall team including: approving timesheets, leave, performance management, change requests, customer concerns, incidents, critical issue management, training and mentoring Responding to ad-hoc initiatives and requests from additional workstreams Updating all relevant documentation and in related information repositories Liaise with divisions and departmental heads to both discover and detail all the processes, actions and outcomes required Certify that the teams create, modify, and delete Privileged user accounts and create and manage security groups to documented standards Ensure accurate Privileged account provisioning and de-provisioning according to company policies. Ensure Privileged users have appropriate access to network resources based on their roles. Apply the principle of least privilege to ensure secure access to organisational resources. Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor Active Directory for unauthorised access attempts, security breaches, and compliance violations using Privileged accounts. Review regular reports on Beyond Trust avoidance as well as user/group activity, group memberships, and security compliance. Track and document any changes made to Privileged user accounts, groups, or permissions. Stay up to date with the latest Active Directory features, security patches, and standard methodologies. Maintain accurate documentation on Active Directory Privileged user/group management procedures. Identify areas for process improvements and implement changes to improve efficiency and security for all the GSAC Processes. Assist in the development of Privileged user access policies and standards. Required Skills Minimum of 3-5 years of Active Directory knowledge including hierarchy / management group design, deployment, configuration and BAU support. Experience with all aspects of AD user and group Management Must be confident to collaborate closely with service line owners and customers Experience working in an Enterprise environment with strong change control practices Self- starter who takes initiative Able to use AD tools to a sophisticated level Familiar with Service Now and organisational change processes Communicate effectively, particularly with issues that are more sophisticated with other customers and teams, referring when vital. Use developed communication skills so others can understand, with the ability to recognise when to refer issues appropriately. Proactively prioritise knowledge transfer sessions to enable team members to demonstrate the functionality of all new implementations within the Windows Security environment. Highly Desirable Skills Solid grasp of Windows Active Directory Administration Proven management experience, leading shifts and teams Excellent verbal and document authoring skills Power BI & Power Apps/ CNX /Splunk Knowledge of PAM products such as Beyond Trust/ Cyber Ark/ Advanced Excel Key Behaviours Maintain proficiency as a Windows Active Directory Administrator /Architect with Active Directory Systems Speciality Excellent investigation and troubleshooting skills of complex issues and ability to locate application owners and liaise effectively with them. Motivated self-starter who can work independently as well as part of a team. High level of accuracy and attention to detail. Able to take direction from others when needed and not afraid to ask for help. Ability to learn new concepts and products with ease. Ability to think quickly and decisively and look for alternative solutions in challenging situations. Ability to produce clear and accurate technical documentation and train/hand-off design and implementation work. Ability to work to tight timescales and meet challenging deadlines. Ability to report in a formal and structured method. Strengths and attributes you'll need Demonstrate energy and drive in getting things done. Evaluate the quality of the service(s) we provide and always try to do better. Committed to personal development and learning for themselves and for their team. Show insight into their own behaviour and the behaviours of others. Understand how to embed change so that improvements are sustainable and consistent. title: Graph Database Engineer
jobDescription: Graph Database Engineer – Operational Risk and Controls Engineering Company Profile LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is a world-leading financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering services across Data & Analytics, Capital Markets, and Post Trade. Backed by three hundred years of experience, innovative technologies, and a team of over 23,000 people in 70 countries, our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies, and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. Role Profile ·We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer specialising in Graph Databases and Graph Analytics to join our Resilience Engineering team. Working with the Engineering Lead, you will design, develop, and operate graph-based data platforms and solutions that enable critical resilience, operational risk, dependency mapping, and control management use cases across the organisation. ·You will work closely with engineers, architects, product owners, risk specialists, and business customers to model complex relationships between applications, infrastructure, services, controls, processes, and organisational entities. Using technologies such as Neo4j, you will help create actionable insights that improve operational resilience, impact analysis, dependency management, and decision-making Key Responsibilities Graph Data Platform Engineering ·Build and maintain scalable graph data solutions using Neo4j and related technologies. ·Develop graph data models representing applications, services, infrastructure, business processes, controls, risks, and dependencies. ·Implement data ingestion, transformation, and enrichment pipelines from multiple enterprise data sources. ·Optimise graph schemas, queries, and data structures to support high-performance analytics and visualisation. Resilience Engineering Use Cases ·Support operational resilience initiatives through graph-based dependency mapping and critical service modelling. ·Develop solutions for impact analysis, scenario modelling, control coverage assessment, and risk propagation analysis. ·Enable identification of single points of failure, concentration risks, and resilience vulnerabilities. ·Support regulatory, audit, and governance requirements through accurate and traceable data relationships. Data Engineering & Integration ·Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines using the latest data engineering practices. ·Integrate graph platforms with enterprise data ecosystems, APIs, data lakes, and operational systems. ·Implement monitoring, observability, and automated testing for graph data pipelines. Collaboration & Delivery ·Work closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners, and partners to define requirements and deliver solutions. ·Contribute to architecture decisions, technical standards, and engineering guidelines. ·Participate in Agile ceremonies and support continuous delivery and Dev Sec Ops practices. Required Skills & Experience Technical Skills Strong experience as a Data Engineer, Software Engineer, or Graph Data Engineer. Hands-on expertise with Neo4j, including Cypher query language and graph data modelling. Experience in implementing graph-based solutions in enterprise environments. Proficiency in Python, Java or similar programming languages. Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases. Experience building data pipelines using modern data engineering frameworks and tools. Experience working with APIs, data integration patterns, and cloud-native architectures. Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data quality frameworks. Graph & Analytics Expertise Strong understanding of graph theory, network analysis, and relationship-based data modelling. Experience implementing graph algorithms for pathfinding, centrality analysis, clustering, and dependency analysis. Familiarity with graph visualisation and analytics platforms. Experience applying graph technologies to operational risk, resilience, fraud, cybersecurity, knowledge graphs, or similar domains is highly desirable. Cloud & Platform Experience Experience with AWS or Azure cloud platforms Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code practices. Preferred Qualifications ·Strong experience supporting operational resilience, risk management, or enterprise architecture initiatives; using graph technologies (Neo4j preferred but not required). ·Neo4j certification or equivalent graph technology expertise. Certification in any other graph technology would also be advantageous ·Experience with graph data science libraries and sophisticated analytics. ·Understanding of distributed systems, service architectures, and enterprise technology landscapes. ·Experience in financial services, regulated industries, or large-scale enterprise environments (preferable, not required) Personal Attributes ·Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. ·Ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical partners. ·Excellent communication and documentation skills. ·Curious, collaborative, and delivery-focused attitude. ·Passion for using technologies to address business challenges. What You’ll Deliver ·Enterprise graph models supporting resilience and dependency management. ·High-quality graph data pipelines and analytics capabilities. ·Enhanced visibility of critical service dependencies and operational risks. ·Actionable insights that improve resilience, decision-making, and regulatory compliance. ·A scalable graph data foundation supporting future resilience engineering initiatives LSEG Purpose and Values Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth. title: Senior Security Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Profile: Do you want to work with some of the latest technology platforms and address exciting and sophisticated challenges? If you are ready to use your expertise to drive security excellence on a global scale, we would love to hear from you! We are seeking a Senior Cyber Security Engineer who will work with the existing team to perform security tools support activities across LSEG. The role works closely with engineering & other support teams, and customers to deliver outcomes which align to our ambition for LSEG to be one of the world’s great companies! Role

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Participate in a 24/7 Cyber Security Support team, adhering to a rotational shift pattern. Provide Level 2 support for Crowd Strike, Cyber Ark EPM, Vormetric, Qualys, Varonis, Mc Afee (e PO, ENS, ENSSP), and other solutions, including fix technical issues reported by users or detected through monitoring systems. Knowledge of routine maintenance tasks such as system upgrades, patch installations, and configuration changes to ensure the stability and security of our environments. Complete 2nd level support tasks, which involve responding to alerts/emails, handling Service Now tickets (Incident, Change, Problem) within SLA, conducting root cause analysis, and resolving problems efficiently. Assist in the planning and execution of Cyber Security-related projects, such as new implementations, migrations, and enhancements, following established project management methodologies and timelines. Collaborate with various IT disciplines within the organization to deliver the outcomes. Work closely with our partners to ensure that security configurations are implemented. Take ownership of continuous improvement initiatives, focusing on process simplification and the automation of day-to-day tasks within the cyber security domain. Keep abreast of industry trends and standard methodologies in privileged access management, actively seeking opportunities to improve skills and knowledge through training, certifications, and professional development activities. Key Accountabilities: Serve as the main point of contact and liaison for support groups and internal business customers during the recovery of major incidents, offering technical expertise and domain knowledge as necessary. Adhere to the IT Service Management (ITSM) process and overarching execution framework to uphold Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Take charge of major incidents, including defining and executing tasks, orchestrating break-fix changes and recovery actions, evaluating impact, and monitoring progress to ensure timely resolution and maintain business continuity. Continuously enhance and apply pertinent domain knowledge related to workflows, data pipelines, business policies, configurations, and constraints in a proactive manner. Take responsibility for the day-to-day operation and upkeep of Cyber Security Tools. This includes performing routine maintenance tasks, such as upgrades, patches, and configuration changes, to ensure optimal system performance and security. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation related to configurations, processes, and procedures. Share knowledge and standard processes with team members and customers to facilitate effective support and promote continuous improvement. Experience: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field preferred. Demonstrable experience in administering Endpoint Protection in enterprise environments, including installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. Solid understanding of privileged access management concepts, principles, and standard methodologies. Good understanding of Windows/Linux Administration and troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Power Shell, Python) for automation and customization of Cyber Security functionalities. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues efficiently. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with multi-functional teams and customers. Relevant certificates such Crowd Strike Certification or Cyber Ark EPM certification is preferred. jobDescription: Senior Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering (Cloud Focus: AWS & Azure) Our Team We are evolving our Reliability Engineering team to move beyond support and operations. As a Senior Engineer in Site Reliability, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive organization that has full ownership of the availability, performance, and scalability of one of the most critical shared services at LSEG. We are looking for people with a passion to learn, and who bring a continuous improvement mentality to our team! Main Responsibilities Maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for cloud-hosted systems, continuously measuring and improving availability, latency, and overall system health. Design and implement automation for AWS and Azure environments to scale systems sustainably, prevent service issues, and enable rapid recovery. Partner with development teams to improve reliability, observability, and release velocity using cloud-native tools and guidelines. Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, postmortems, and root cause analysis. Advocate for strong engineering practices for building, deploying, and running scalable, reliable services across AWS and Azure. Enable cloud migration by performing architectural reviews, operational readiness testing, and configuring observability dashboards (e.g., Datadog integrated with AWS Cloud Watch and Azure Monitor). Incident response and blameless postmortems. Proficient in Git workflows. Preferred Qualifications 8–10 years of proven experience. Strong understanding of AWS Well-Architected Framework and Azure Architecture Center. Experience with cloud security guidelines (IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager). Familiarity with cloud-native databases (AWS RDS/Dynamo DB, Azure SQL). Knowledge of Dev Ops concepts and modern cloud-native architectures. Industry reputation as a technical expert or AI thought leader.

title: Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: Manager, Site Reliability Engineering – Shared Services We are seeking an experienced technical and people leader to join our Risk Intelligence Site Reliability Engineering team as Manager – Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). This role is responsible for the reliability and performance of shared services platforms underpinning critical authentication, API, data intelligence, and data warehouse capabilities. You will lead a high-performing SRE team, ensuring these platforms meet high availability, scalability, security, and compliance standards in line with our global Risk Intelligence offerings. The role combines hands-on technical leadership with end-to-end ownership of reliability, incident management, and operational excellence. Working closely with product engineering, data, and risk team members, you will drive a product-led SRE approach embedding resilience, observability, and automation into the platform lifecycle while supporting a unified, scalable operating model across all Risk Intelligence products. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Platform Reliability Own 24×7 reliability and operational excellence for Shared Services platforms (Risk Intelligence Hub, Risk Intelligence Hyper Gateway, Risk Intelligence Lakehouse), ensuring high availability, performance, and security. Define, implement, and continuously improve SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets aligned to business criticality and customer impact. • Lead major incident response as Incident Commander; drive blameless post-incident reviews and ensure learnings translate into systemic improvements. Champion an automation-first approach across incident response, deployment, monitoring, compliance, and operational workflows. Partner with platform and product engineering teams to embed non-functional requirements (reliability, scalability, security, observability) early in the SDLC. Co-own the cloud reliability roadmap, driving standardisation of observability, alerting, ITSM, and incident communication tooling. Ensure disaster recovery (DR), business continuity (BCP), and resilience patterns are consistently implemented, tested, and audit-ready. People Leadership & Site Ownership Lead, mentor, and develop a team of SRE engineers, fostering a culture of accountability, learning, and engineering excellence. Own performance management, career development, succession planning, and capability building for the team. Partner with HR and Talent teams to support workforce planning, strategic hiring, and onboarding in Bangalore. Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and well-being while ensuring adherence to health and safety standards. Represent the Bangalore site in global SRE and Shared Services forums. Lead and govern vendor and partner engagements. Support site-level operational readiness, including BCP/DR exercises and critical event preparedness. Required Skills & Experience 10+ years of experience in production operations, SRE, or Dev Ops roles, including 3+ years in a people management role. Proven experience operating cloud-native services on AWS at scale. Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker). Expertise in CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, or similar). Experience with observability and incident management platforms (Datadog, Big Panda, Open Telemetry, etc.). Strong analytical and problem-solving approach. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Nice to have: experience supporting Snowflake platforms, including reliability, performance tuning, and cost efficiency. Desirable Experience Experience in financial services or investment banking. Familiarity with ITIL, ISO 27001, or related frameworks. Exposure to structured major incident management frameworks. Experience with cost optimization and cloud financial management. Personal Attributes Passionate about engineering excellence, automation, and reliability at scale. Strong people leader with a track record of building and retaining high-performing teams. Strategic problem solver with a bias for action, ownership, and accountability. Calm and decisive under pressure, especially during high-severity incidents. Strong collaborator across global teams. Effective communicator. Committed to continuous learning and improvement. Benefits LSEG offers a competitive compensation package, including equity, annual bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed and build an exciting career. LSEG values respect, integrity, excellence, and innovation and encourages our employees to embody those values every day! This is achieved through leading the world in providing access to capital, helping customers optimise capital resources and promoting trusted and open environments and services for investment. The Group operates through four key business divisions: Capital Markets (broad range of international equity, bond and derivatives markets); Post Trade (post trade and risk management services); Global Technology Services (trading platforms and capital markets software); and Information Services (real-time and reference data products).As a global business, LSEG relies on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. jobDescription: Lead Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering Our Team We are evolving our Reliability Engineering team to move beyond support and operations. As a Senior Engineer in Site Reliability, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive organization that has full ownership of the availability, performance, and scalability of one of the most critical shared services at LSEG. Main responsibilities We are looking for people with a passion to learn, and who bring a continuous improvement mentality to our team! SREs maintain Service Level Objectives for the systems they own. title: Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join a product suite within the Risk Intelligence business. This role is based in Bangalore, India, and will be responsible for executing reliability engineering practices, supporting platform operations, and contributing to automation and observability initiatives. The successful candidate will have strong technical skills in cloud infrastructure, SRE principles, and operational tooling. This role will work closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to ensure services are reliable, scalable, and secure. Key Responsibilities Reliability Engineering & Operations Support reliability operations across platforms. Monitor and maintain SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets. Participate in incident response and post-incident reviews; contribute to root cause analysis and remediation. Develop automation for operational tasks, incident response, and compliance. Maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines with integrated testing and deployment automation. Implement observability dashboards and alerts using Datadog, Open Telemetry, and Big Panda. Contribute to infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and Git Hub Actions. Support integration and maintenance of Kong API Gateway and Snowflake data platform. Service Management & Compliance Follow ITIL practices for incident, problem, change, and service request management. Use Service Now for ticketing, reporting, and workflow automation. Ensure runbook accuracy and DR readiness. Monitor system performance and cost efficiency. Support compliance and audit readiness activities. Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing Work with engineering and product teams to embed reliability into delivery. Share technical knowledge through documentation and enablement sessions. Participate in global SRE initiatives and cross-regional collaboration. Person Specification Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field or equivalent practical experience. Required Skills and Experience Experience with Azure and AWS cloud services. Proficiency in:Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins Datadog, Open Telemetry, Big Panda Kong API Gateway, Snowflake, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB Understanding of SRE principles and operational metrics. Experience with Service Now and ITIL-aligned service management. Strong troubleshooting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash). Personal Attributes Detail-oriented and proactive. Structured in incident response and operational execution. Strong communicator and team player. Passionate about automation, reliability, and continuous improvement. Committed to learning and contributing to team success. Benefits LSEG offers a competitive compensation package, including equity, annual bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage. title: Senior AI Engineer(Python Developer)
jobDescription: You'll be joining our FX Trade Advanced Analytics team as a Senior AI Engineer. We're responsible for building and delivering complex analytic applications across our regulated FX trading venues. Advanced Analytics team provides traders with the ability to assess historical trading data with comparisons of liquidity providers and data visualization technology. Our existing analytic capability processes millions of FX trade messages every day on cloud through our big data stack including Python, Snow Park, Oracle and Snowflake. Responsibilities You will be responsible for designing and implementing new analytic and AI‑driven application capabilities within our Big Data analytics ecosystem. This includes building production grade systems that integrate traditional data engineering with modern AI frameworks. You will need strong technical abilities, be able to quickly understand and contribute to existing codebases and express design concepts with a solid understanding of functional programming paradigms and AI system design. As a senior AI engineer, you will be responsible for engineering scalable solutions, maintaining rigorous quality standards, contributing to Agile Scrum processes, and at times interacting directly with product stakeholders. Required Skills Solid grasp of Python, including experience building production systems in cloud environments and working with big data warehouses (preferably Snowflake). Hands on experience with AI/LLM engineering, Agentic AI, including building applications using Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks. Hands-on experience with Snowflake Cortex, including building or integrating AI/ML pipelines using Cortex functions and services. Integrating LLMs (Open AI, Azure Open AI, Anthropic, etc.) into production systems. 7+ years of relevant software engineering experience. 3+ years delivering application solutions, ideally using big data technologies. Demonstrated ability to contribute independently while collaborating effectively as part of a team on high profile projects. Additional Skills and Experience Some knowledge of, or willingness to learn, technologies such as Snowpark, AWS Lambda, Terraform Oracle and Hive Unit and Integration testing your code (including mocking) Proficient with version-control solutions using Git Continuous integration (Gitlab, Bamboo, Jenkins) and/or deployment (Terraform) Knowledge of embedding models, vector search optimization, and LLM observability/monitoring tools. title: Specialist- Workforce Strategy
jobDescription:
The Workforce Strategy team delivers data-driven insights, analytics, and services to ensure Customer Operations maintains optimal staffing levels to meet business demands. This role provides actionable intelligence to delivery teams across areas such as forecasting and planning, operational efficiency, headcount management, and workspace utilization. Additionally, it serves as a critical liaison between Customer Operations, Human Resources, and Finance, enabling alignment and informed decision-making.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Forecasting & Capacity Planning Develop detailed and accurate headcount capacity plans (long-term/short-term) to be shared with the Finance and Operations teams for budgeting purposes Workforce Planner will be Responsible to deliver the forecasting for the number of interactions, processing time, shrinkage, attrition and/or other required metrics and input management process by use of statistical forecasting models and analysis. Responsible for the capacity and staffing of one or more accounts, providing guidelines and directions for the schedule creation. Reporting & Analytics BI and Data analytics Expertise in Power BI tool Good knowledge of database management and data modelling Expertise in DAX, SQL, and other analytical tools Efficiency Tracking Provide robust measures of efficiency/productivity for each major business delivery team function Identify Areas of opportunities and work with Operations, Reporting and Workflow teams to address the inefficiencies Scheduling · Scheduling and shift optimization for Customer Support roles Partner Engagement Work closely with Operations team, HR and Finance partners to ensure Workforce Planning meets the business needs Develop and maintain internal control, setting benchmarks and giving feedback on data performance and recommended actions. Develop and produce performance information to advise, engage and influence various levels of operational management based on the Power BI dashboards with performance reports

QUALIFICATIONS:
Minimum of 8 years of experience in Workforce Management, including prior expertise in capacity planning Proven experience in running a workforce management program, delivering resourcing plans for a variety of support and back-office processing functions. Deep understanding of Capacity plan build, scheduling, workforce planning, tools and methodology Ability to create executive summaries that deliver a clear, compelling narrative of actionable insights and performance outcomes Must have Power Bi expertise Excellent database leadership skills Should have good analytical, Interpersonal & Problem-Solving skills. Understanding of business processes improvement and methods of working Exceptional communication, customer management skills and experience partnering with senior business leaders Experience working in a highly sophisticated global matrix environment Excellent planning, administration and organization skills Proven ability to perform effectively under high-pressure situations and meet tight deadlines. Capable of independently managing tasks with minimal oversight; a proactive self-starter who quickly adapts to evolving requirements. title: Lead Database SRE
jobDescription: JOB TITLE: Lead Database SRE DEPARTMENT: Infrastructure Platform Engineering REPORTING TO: Senior Manager – Database SRE Role Overview The Lead Database SRE is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, and automation of enterprise database platforms supporting critical business applications. This role blends deep database engineering expertise with SRE and Dev Ops principles to ensure highly available, performant, and resilient database services. The role provides both production and development support for database platforms, with strong ownership of operational excellence, automation, incident response, performance engineering, and cloud database operations. The Lead Database SRE acts as a technical authority, customer concern point, and catalyst in modernising database operations through Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices. This position has a proven focus on Oracle and SQL databases hosted on Microsoft Azure, including the migration of on prem workloads to cloud-native and hybrid architectures. Key Responsibilities Reliability, Operations & Support Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of database platforms supporting business critical applications. Act as a point of escalation for sophisticated database production incidents and service disruptions. Participate in on-call rotations and shift cover, including non-standard tasks when required. Investigate and resolve incidents using SRE practices such as root cause analysis, error budgets, and post-incident reviews. Monitor database health, capacity, and performance, ensuring proactive issue prevention. Database Engineering & Administration Develop, implement, and maintain database build standards, including security, patching, backup, and HA/DR. Perform database performance tuning, diagnostics, and optimization using tools such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, and execution plan analysis. Define and document backup, restore, upgrade, and disaster recovery procedures. Support database connectivity using ODBC, JDBC, and vendor-specific drivers. Provide database build and advisory support to development and application teams. Review database application code, collaborate on improvements, and maintain artefacts using standard source control tools. SRE, Dev Ops & Automation Develop and implement automation for database provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management. Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C) using tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Develop and support CI/CD pipelines for database deployments and schema changes. Define and maintain a database observability and alerting strategy, combining automated alerts with targeted manual checks. Promote and implement self-healing, standardisation, and automation-first approaches across database services. Cloud & Migration Lead solution design and implementation of Oracle and SQL databases on Microsoft Azure. Implement and support database migrations from on premise to Azure, ensuring security, resilience, and performance. Work closely with application, cloud, and architecture teams to build scalable and secure database environments. Ensure alignment with enterprise database standards and cloud security controls. Security & Compliance Partner with IT Security teams to maintain and implement database security policies. Apply industry-standard security and compliance controls for database access, encryption, auditing, and identity management. Evaluate applications and database usage to ensure policy alignment. Required Technical Skills & Experience Core SRE / Dev Ops Skills Demonstrable experience with SRE and Dev Ops practices for stateful systems. Automation and scripting using Python, Bash/Korn Shell, Power Shell. Experience with Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, Git Hub/Git Lab, Bitbucket, Rundeck). Familiarity with secrets management (Hashi Corp Vault). Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm). Database Technologies Extensive hands-on experience with: Oracle Databases (11g, 12c, 19c, up to 23ai) RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM/ACFS, Data Guard Exadata, RMAN, OEM PL/SQL, APEX Experience with SQL Server (2008–2022) and/or Postgre SQL. Solid understanding of HA/DR architectures and replication technologies. Cloud & Platforms Good experience with Microsoft Azure database platforms. Exposure to AWS (RDS) and hybrid cloud database deployments. Linux administration experience (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Solaris X86/Sparc). Additional Requirements Experience supporting critical platforms in multi datacentre or multi region environments. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate calmly under pressure. Understanding of ITIL service management frameworks. Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and observability tools. Experience in the finance or banking sector is helpful. Optional / Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with Delphix. Exposure to Service Now, Control M, Citrix, or web development platforms. Knowledge of My SQL, Mongo DB, Perl scripting. Experience with database migration tools, distributed transactions, and data warehousing platforms. Behavioural & Leadership Skills Strong influencing and partner management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication at technical and business levels. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Collaborative demeanor with a proven sense of ownership. Proactive, self motivated, and committed to continuous improvement. Willingness to share knowledge and mentor others. Pragmatic and outcome-focused approach to problem solving. jobDescription:
Are you ready to dive into the fast-paced world of ground-breaking finance and technology? If you have a passion for innovation, a thirst for challenge, and a love for all things fintech, then look no further! LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our Risk Intelligence division within the Digital Identity & Fraud (DI&F) Platform team. In this role, you will work closely with multiple development teams to build and enhance our latest platform offering for Digital Identity flagship products. In addition, you will help key business stakeholders to translate their vision into reality by owning each and all of the following phases: Architecture and design, Security first mindset, epic and story collaboration, agile development, 3rd party vendor API integration and delivery. We build products that run at scale for large financial institutions, and our platform supports that vision. Experience with event-driven architecture and message brokering tools including Rabbit MQ, AWS MQ, or Azure Queue. Familiarity with No SQL databases like Mongo DB, Dynamo DB, or Cosmos DB. Experience working with highly distributed, data-intensive systems. experienceProfile.rawText: Role Overview The Manager - Database SRE is responsible for leading and scaling the Database Site Reliability Engineering function, ensuring the reliability, security, performance, and availability of enterprise database platforms supporting critical business services. This role combines technical leadership, people management, and platform ownership, driving the adoption of SRE principles, automation, and cloud‑native database practices across both commercial and open‑source database technologies. The Manager Database SRE sets the strategic vision for database reliability and operational excellence, while partnering closely with application, cloud, security, and architecture teams. The role has a main focus on Oracle and SQL databases, with growing responsibility for open‑source and cloud‑native databases including Postgre SQL, My SQL, and No SQL platforms such as Azure Cosmos DB. Key Responsibilities Leadership & People Management Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Lead and Senior Database SREs, encouraging a high‑performance and innovating culture. Set clear goals, expectations, and career development plans for team members. Promote SRE standard processes, accountability, and continuous improvement across the team. Act as a critical issue contact for sophisticated operational and organisational challenges. Reliability, Operations & Service Ownership Lead the availability, resilience, and reliability SLAs/SLOs for enterprise database platforms. Be responsible for incident response, major incident command, root cause analysis, and post‑incident reviews. Ensure effective on-call coverage, shift rotations, and operational readiness. Drive proactive capacity management, performance optimisation, and risk reduction initiatives. Ensure platform operations align with business priorities and service expectations. Database Platform Strategy & Engineering Define and evolve the database platform strategy, standards, and roadmaps across: Oracle and SQL Server Open-source databases (Postgre SQL, My SQL) No SQL / cloud databases (Azure Cosmos DB and similar) Ensure standardised approaches for builds, upgrades, patching, backup, recovery, and HA/DR. Supervise complex performance tuning, scalability, and architectural reviews. Guide teams in supporting application and development initiatives with sound database design principles. SRE, Dev Ops & Automation Enablement Champion automation-first and reliability-by-design approaches for all database services. Supervise development of Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C) and configuration management for databases. Ensure consistent use of CI/CD pipelines for database deployments. Define and implement observability, monitoring, and alerting standards for database platforms. Encourage adoption of self-healing, standardisation, and continuous testing practices. Cloud, Migration & Modernisation Lead the design and governance of database services on Microsoft Azure. Supervise and govern database migrations from on‑premise to Azure, including hybrid and phased approaches. Partner with cloud, security, and architecture teams to build secure, scalable, cloud‑native database platforms. Support modernization initiatives across RDBMS and No SQL platforms. Security, Risk & Compliance Partner with IT Security and Risk teams to define and implement database security policies. Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and enterprise security requirements. Be responsible for implementation of encryption, auditing, access controls, and secrets management. Evaluate applications and platform usage for alignment to security and compliance standards. Required Technical Skills & Experience Database Technologies Strong expertise in Oracle Database platforms, including: 11g through 23ai RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM/ACFS, Data Guard Exadata, RMAN, OEM PL/SQL, APEX Strong solid understanding of SQL Server. Practical experience managing and supporting: Postgre SQL My SQL No SQL / cloud databases such as Azure Cosmos DB Deep understanding of HA/DR architectures, replication technologies, and data consistency models. SRE / Dev Ops & Automation Proven experience applying SRE principles in large, sophisticated environments. Experience with automation and scripting (Python, Bash/Korn Shell, Power Shell). Hands-on knowledge of Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, Git Hub/Git Lab, Bitbucket, Rundeck). Familiarity with secrets management (Hashi Corp Vault). Exposure to container and orchestration ecosystems (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm). Cloud & Platforms Solid experience with Microsoft Azure database services. Exposure to AWS database platforms is beneficial. Proven Linux platform knowledge (Red Hat Enterprise Linux; Solaris experience advantageous). Additional Requirements Experience leading business‑critical platforms across multi‑datacentre or multi‑region environments. Strong collaborator management and decision‑making skills. Ability to prioritise work, handle risk, and communicate trade‑offs clearly to senior interested parties. Experience in finance or banking environments is highly advantageous.
