title: Application Risk Assessment - Senior Analyst
jobDescription:
Application Health (App Health) is a new Product Risk Assessment initiative to provide greater visibility and assessment to the Cyber and Technology Risk aspects of LSEG’s in-service application estate. This capability will also be used to deliver business as usual regulatory oversight for Cyber and Technology Risk requirements. Reporting to the Product Owner for Product Risk Assessment, this role will provide the engine of the App Health function. Working collaboratively with the LSEG Application Owner population, this role will: Technical: Apply the App Health tooling and detection techniques. Support policy enforcement and response plans using insights provided by App Health. Understand root causes, challenge assumptions, and assist Application Owners by correct selection of secure design, secure pattern design and security architecture reviews. Customer Focus: I consider customer needs in my work, contribute ideas to improve our product, respond quickly to operational issues that affect or risk affecting customers, and seek feedback with other Cyber and Tech Risk groups to improve how we work. Risk Management: I conduct the Product Risk Assessment reviews which form the core of the role. I drive Product Risk Assessment reviews and evidence assessments. I implement incremental improvements and use the data provided by Product Risk Assessments to contribute to visibility of controls. Leadership: Take accountability for delivering reliable work. I support and coach peers and share knowledge openly. I contribute to team outcomes by collaborating effectively and helping others succeed through trust and shared ownership. Analytical: I apply structured thinking and data to review the responses to Product Risk Assessment responses, solve problems identified as part of the Product Risk Assessment activity, test assumptions, and learn from outcomes. I support team decisions through evidence, insight, and continuous improvement. Work with the App Health Product Owner to establish and systemise reporting on App Health’s results and outcome to the broad stakeholder groups within LSEG. Adaptability: I continuously learn and adapt to new priorities, try different approaches, and share what works with my team. I make learning my craft a regular habit, not just something I pick up through daily work. Communication: I contribute to team discussions and communicate clearly with peers. I share context, ask questions and help the team align around shared work. The App Health initiative is currently in the early stages of operation after successful trials, with a defined future demand and enhancement runway and developing target operating model. This includes both technology and greater alignment with the Group’s corporate planning function; providing insight and feedback on targeted risk reduction activity. This role is within a broader Security Architecture team comprising the Secure Design group. Other teams within the Security Architecture function work with engineering teams; with a separate group delivering a formal control function for Security Architecture. As outlined above, an element of this role is to assist with connecting the outputs and outcomes of Application Health assessments with inputs to other Engineering teams, providing a feedback loop to enhance the Group’s overall security and technology risk posture. Reports to: Product Owner

title: Lead Database SRE
jobDescription: JOB TITLE: Lead Database SRE DEPARTMENT: Infrastructure Platform Engineering REPORTING TO: Senior Manager – Database SRE Role Overview The Lead Database SRE is responsible for the reliability, scalability, security, and automation of enterprise database platforms supporting critical business applications. This role blends deep database engineering expertise with SRE and Dev Ops principles to ensure highly available, performant, and resilient database services. The role provides both production and development support for database platforms, with strong ownership of operational excellence, automation, incident response, performance engineering, and cloud database operations. The Lead Database SRE acts as a technical authority, customer concern point, and catalyst in modernising database operations through Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD practices. This position has a proven focus on Oracle and SQL databases hosted on Microsoft Azure, including the migration of on prem workloads to cloud-native and hybrid architectures. Key Responsibilities Reliability, Operations & Support Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of database platforms supporting business critical applications. Act as a point of escalation for sophisticated database production incidents and service disruptions. Participate in on-call rotations and shift cover, including non-standard tasks when required. Investigate and resolve incidents using SRE practices such as root cause analysis, error budgets, and post-incident reviews. Monitor database health, capacity, and performance, ensuring proactive issue prevention. Database Engineering & Administration Develop, implement, and maintain database build standards, including security, patching, backup, and HA/DR. Perform database performance tuning, diagnostics, and optimization using tools such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, and execution plan analysis. Define and document backup, restore, upgrade, and disaster recovery procedures. Support database connectivity using ODBC, JDBC, and vendor-specific drivers. Provide database build and advisory support to development and application teams. Review database application code, collaborate on improvements, and maintain artefacts using standard source control tools. SRE, Dev Ops & Automation Develop and implement automation for database provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management. Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C) using tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Develop and support CI/CD pipelines for database deployments and schema changes. Define and maintain a database observability and alerting strategy, combining automated alerts with targeted manual checks. Promote and implement self-healing, standardisation, and automation-first approaches across database services. Cloud & Migration Lead solution design and implementation of Oracle and SQL databases on Microsoft Azure. Implement and support database migrations from on premise to Azure, ensuring security, resilience, and performance. Work closely with application, cloud, and architecture teams to build scalable and secure database environments. Ensure alignment with enterprise database standards and cloud security controls. Security & Compliance Partner with IT Security teams to maintain and implement database security policies. Apply industry-standard security and compliance controls for database access, encryption, auditing, and identity management. Evaluate applications and database usage to ensure policy alignment. Required Technical Skills & Experience Core SRE / Dev Ops Skills Demonstrable experience with SRE and Dev Ops practices for stateful systems. Automation and scripting using Python, Bash/Korn Shell, Power Shell. Experience with Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, Git Hub/Git Lab, Bitbucket, Rundeck). Familiarity with secrets management (Hashi Corp Vault). Exposure to containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm). Database Technologies Extensive hands-on experience with: Oracle Databases (11g, 12c, 19c, up to 23ai) RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM/ACFS, Data Guard Exadata, RMAN, OEM PL/SQL, APEX Experience with SQL Server (2008–2022) and/or Postgre SQL. Solid understanding of HA/DR architectures and replication technologies. Cloud & Platforms Good experience with Microsoft Azure database platforms. Exposure to AWS (RDS) and hybrid cloud database deployments. Linux administration experience (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Solaris X86/Sparc). Additional Requirements Experience supporting critical platforms in multi datacentre or multi region environments. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate calmly under pressure. Understanding of ITIL service management frameworks. Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and observability tools. Experience in the finance or banking sector is helpful. Optional / Nice-to-Have Skills Experience with Delphix. Exposure to Service Now, Control M, Citrix, or web development platforms. Knowledge of My SQL, Mongo DB, Perl scripting. Experience with database migration tools, distributed transactions, and data warehousing platforms. Behavioural & Leadership Skills Strong influencing and partner management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication at technical and business levels. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Collaborative demeanor with a proven sense of ownership. Proactive, self motivated, and committed to continuous improvement. Willingness to share knowledge and mentor others. Pragmatic and outcome-focused approach to problem solving. jobDescription: ABOUT US: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG. OUR PEOPLE: People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We accept diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. title: Enterprise Tooling JIRA Support Engineer
jobDescription: Role Profile The Atlassian JIRA Engineer will be part of the Engineering team An Atlassian Engineer (Jira Engineer) configures, administers, and optimizes Atlassian tools—primarily Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence—to streamline team workflows and improve project management. They customize workflows, manage permissions, integrate tools, and maintain system performance, usually requiring 8+ years of experience, scripting skills, and strong analytical. This position requires strong knowledge of Atlassian Tools like JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket. It also requires knowledge on any one Strategic Portfolio tools like Clarity, Planview and Service Now and must have experience in integration of these strategic Enterprise Tooling applications. This position will be accountable for defining solutions on assigned projects for Enterprise Tooling, documenting the solution, and coordinating with Enterprise Architect team in taking the solution through the LSEG governance processes wherever applicable. The Role will have to work with the Enterprise Tooling Product Owner/s to propose solutions to the requirements. This position will need to recommend future Atlassian product Roadmap to align strategically with organization’s Enterprise Tooling Framework. Key Responsibilities Administration & Configuration: Install, configure, and maintain Jira and Confluence, including creating complex workflows, custom fields, screens, and dashboards. Workflow Optimization: Collaborate with stakeholders to map business processes into Atlassian tools and implement workflow automation to reduce manual tasks. System Maintenance: Monitor system performance, perform upgrades, manage user permissions/roles, and ensure the security and reliability of the platform. Integrations & Scripting: Integrate Jira with CI/CD tools (e.g., Bitbucket), chat platforms, and other systems using REST APIs, scripting languages like Groovy, Python, or Java Script. User Support & Documentation: Provide technical support and documentation for users and create documentation for tools and processes. Strong understanding of the reporting Framework Handle L3 support tickets individually with in agreed SLAs. Work with LSEG Architecture group in defining potential technology solutions and ensuring adherence to architectural principles. Collaborate with business and functional leads to socialise technology projects and obtain cross functional approvals from Legal, Group Risk, Compliance, LCH Ltd/LCH SA, Candidate Profile / Key Skills Workflow Mastery: Expertise in designing and managing complex workflows, including the use of conditions, validators, and post-functions to enforce business rules. JQL (Jira Query Language): Advanced proficiency in JQL for creating complex filters, reports, and dashboards. Scheme Management: Strong understanding of Jira's architecture, including permission schemes, notification schemes, and issue type screen schemes. Jira Service Management (JSM) & ITSM: Knowledge of IT Service Management processes, including setting up SLAs, automation rules, and customer portals Script Runner & Groovy: Proficiency in Groovy scripting to extend Jira functionality beyond its native out-of-the-box capabilities. API Integration: Deep knowledge of REST APIs for integrating Atlassian tools with other enterprise systems (e.g., Slack, Git Hub, or internal tools). Programming: Foundational skills in Java, Python, or Java Script (specifically Node.js/React for the Atlassian Forge platform) for building custom plugins or apps Agile Proficiency: Solid understanding of Scrum and Kanban frameworks to ensure Jira configurations effectively support development teams. Infrastructure & OS: Familiarity with Linux/Windows environments and relational databases (SQL). Version Control: Competency with Git/Bitbucket to manage CI/CD pipelines and source code integrations Cloud and Saa S Implementation System Integration AI chatbot, LLMs knowledge is preferred. Stakeholder Management Reporting Frameworks Degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent experience Proven training in software development lifecycle or methodologies Soft Skills: Strong Planning, organisational and stakeholder holder management, with confidence to challenge preconceptions of outcomes and solutions. Good communication, presentation, documentation, and customer engagement skills with proven ability to work effectively with all organisational levels. Global experience – working successfully with teams in multiple locations simultaneously. title: AWS Solution Architect
jobDescription:
This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key people involved in governing digital and marketing platforms and roadmap across the organisation. As part of the Corporate Technology Architecture team, your role is to guide, advise, and recommend how our digital landscape evolves over the coming years and support the delivery teams offering outstanding solutions. Role Overview: We are looking for a seasoned AWS Solution Architect with over 10 years of experience in designing and delivering robust, scalable, and secure cloud solutions. The ideal candidate should have deep technical expertise across a broad range of AWS services, with a strong focus on data integration, serverless computing, enterprise search, and secure web hosting. This role is critical in shaping our cloud architecture strategy and ensuring alignment with business goals. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Solution Architecture and implement solutions using AWS Glue, Lambda, API Gateway, and Kafka for both real-time and batch data processing. Design and deploy enterprise search platforms such as Elasticsearch to support scalable and efficient data discovery. Lead the development and hosting of web applications on AWS, ensuring high availability, performance, and cost-efficiency. Define and implement security architectures, including WAF (Web Application Firewall) policies and CDN caching strategies (e.g., Cloud Front). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure cloud solutions meet security, compliance, and operational requirements. Conduct architecture reviews, performance tuning, and cost optimisation exercises. Document architectural decisions, patterns, and best practices. Work with Business Stakeholders, Product Owners, Business Analysts to understand functional and non-functional requirements and interact with other cross-functional teams. Contribute to Customer’s digital marketing strategies based on industry best practices. Help project team to size & estimate project implementation and identify resources and skillset needed for delivery of solution. Required Skills & Experience: 10+ years of experience in cloud architecture, with a strong focus on AWS. Hands-on expertise with AWS Glue, Lambda, API Gateway, Kafka. Experience with Elasticsearch or similar enterprise search technologies. Proficiency in Cloud Front, WAF, and other AWS security services. Experience hosting and scaling websites using AWS (e.g., S3, EC2, ECS, Amplify). Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, and compliance frameworks. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Cloud Formation, Terraform). Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (preferred but not mandatory). Experience in enterprise-scale environments or regulated industries. Familiarity with observability tools (e.g., Cloud Watch, Datadog). Personal skills and capabilities Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information to non-technical partners and to listen to identified concerns and adapt accordingly. Ability to influence across multiple functions (technical and non-technical) Quick Leader: Should understand the new implementation patterns and adapt. A continuous desire and willingness to learn and develop your current knowledge and abilities. Flexible in approach, adapting plans and strategies to help handle risks around ambiguity. Problem solver with a strong intuition for business and proficient in current technological trends and business concepts Benefits We are looking for intellectually curious people, passionate about the bigger picture of how technology industry is evolving, ready to ask difficult questions and deal with complicated scenarios! If you are creative and a problem solver, this is the place to be as will be supporting you to fast-forward your career! title: Tech Lead - Database SRE
jobDescription:
About Us: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. As part of the Team, the new resource will support at 360° database layer of several services on different technologies, participate into international projects and have a chance to influence current and future technology choices. There will be occasional weekend work required as Saturdays are used to test and roll forward software and cloud infra releases. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead, develop, support and maintain critical database applications Team management; demand management, maintaining a shift and on-call rota, regular one to ones, team meetings, annual appraisals Gain an in-depth knowledge of the unit’s processes and ensure team compliance with these processes with solid focus on driving down incidents and problems while delivering changes Advocate and promote Engineering principles, drive quality standards across the database suite Have familiarity with security and operational responsibilities Promoting and driving innovation by actively advocating new tools, processes and technical developments to aid CI/CD Drive automation as much as possible Proactively identify operational and project risks. Provide short term solutions whilst tracking long term resolution. Ensure compliance with risk and security policies Partner with the business and technology team members Act as operational SME for the product while also gaining a solid understanding of the underlying database infrastructure and operations/observability toolset Collaborate with the architecture teams to provide insight into operational impacts. Represent the team at unit meetings such as the CAB, incident review, problem review. Writing and maintaining support documentation, technical specifications and user guides. Required Skills: Proven experience with engineering / DEVOPS principles Knowledge of git concepts, CI/CD, release strategy, branching strategy, and development / release pipelines. Able to calmly navigate and work through and resolve engineering and Service issues Assist and guide the team on deployment practices, while implementing improvements to enable further automation of deployments. Good communication skills and the proven track record of working effectively with all organisational levels Continuously adopt a pragmatic, flexible and adaptable approach. Hands on experience of automation Experience with scripting languages; Bash, Groovy, YAML and/or Python Use of CICD tooling such as GIT/Ansible/Jenkins/Nexus/ Preferred Financial services experience Oracle / MSSQL / Postgres /database querying Broad Infrastructure knowledge (Networks, Database, Web, SAN/NAS) Use of JIRA / Kanban to build epics, stories, backlog prioritisation, planning, reporting. SCOM/SCORCH, Control-M, Big Panda, Service Now, Data Dog Understanding of Agile software engineering principles (Dev/ QA / Deployment etc) ITIL qualified Benefits: We are looking for intellectually curious people, passionate about the bigger picture of how technology industry is evolving, ready to ask difficult questions and deal with complicated scenarios! title: Anti-Financial Crime Architect
jobDescription: Role profile: We are looking for an experienced Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) Lead Architect to drive the engineering design and product selection, implementation, integration, and continuous enhancement towards global KYC, CDD, and AML compliance. This role combines engineering leadership, product partnership, and deep collaboration with wider Engineering and Operations teams to strengthen LSEG’s financial crime control environment. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Own the target state architecture for AFC, covering AML, Sanctions, KYC, Fraud, and Investigations. Lead the technical design of a new, cloud‑native AFC platform to replace legacy technology. Define architecture patterns, integration approaches, and technology standards for modern AFC systems. Produce high‑quality architecture artefacts including blueprints, capability models, service catalogues, and process maps. Provide architectural oversight for multi‑year AFC transformation programme Partner with engineering, data, compliance, and operations teams to deliver end‑to‑end functional and technical solutions. Participate in design authorities, technical governance forums, and regulatory review processes. Define data architectures for AFC, including domain models, event schemas, lineage, governance, and quality controls. Support implementation of rules engines, anomaly detection, ML models, and risk‑scoring capabilities. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Essential Skills Proven expertise in delivering architecture and design for modern, cloud‑native AFC platforms and event‑driven architecture. Hands-on design experience with leading KYC/CDD/AML platforms as in-house builds, or vendor platforms like Fenergo, Actimize, Pega, Quantexa, or equivalent. Strong understanding of KYC policy, CDD processes, AML regulations, and customer lifecycle workflows Ability to define and govern target state architectures, reference models, capability maps, and solution blueprints. In depth understanding of key Anti-Financial Crime pillars: Customer Due Diligence / Know your Customer (KYC) Sanctions Screening (customer, payments, entity resolution) Fraud detection and behavioural analytics Case management, investigations, SAR reporting Strong command of data architecture for financial crime, including customer, account, transaction, and risk data models. Demonstrated ability to lead migrations from legacy AFC systems and/or skills in designing data migration strategies Ability to lead architecture workstreams across technology, data, risk, compliance, and operations. Experience supporting design authorities, solutioning guilds, audit and regulatory reviews, and senior stakeholder engagements. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership. Product-oriented engineering mindset with a focus on quality and outcomes. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, regulated financial environment. Analytical and structured problem-solving approach. Desirable skills Experience with banking, payments and/or financial services domain Exposure to machine learning for AFC: anomaly detection, risk scoring, feature stores, explainable AI (XAI). WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: Be part of a global Financial Crime transformation programme. Work with best-in-class vendor platforms and modern engineering stacks. Collaborative, flexible, and globally connected work culture. We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take a hybrid approach to workplace, and this role requires blended workstyle. Underpinning our purpose, our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change set the standard for everything we do, every day. They guide the way we interact with each other, the partners we work with and our customers. Delivering on our purpose and living up to our values is a responsibility that we all share. To achieve our ambitions through a strong culture, People Leaders need to role model our Values and create the culture for everyone at LSEG to be at their best. experienceProfile.rawText: Role profile: We are looking for an experienced Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) Lead Architect to drive the engineering design and product selection, implementation, integration, and continuous enhancement towards global KYC, CDD, and AML compliance. This role combines engineering leadership, product partnership, and deep collaboration with wider Engineering and Operations teams to strengthen LSEG's financial crime control environment. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Own the target state architecture for AFC, covering AML, Sanctions, KYC, Fraud, and Investigations. Lead the technical design of a new, cloud‑native AFC platform to replace legacy technology. Define architecture patterns, integration approaches, and technology standards for modern AFC systems. Produce high‑quality architecture artefacts including blueprints, capability models, service catalogues, and process maps. Provide architectural oversight for multi‑year AFC transformation programme Partner with engineering, data, compliance, and operations teams to deliver end‑to‑end functional and technical solutions. Participate in design authorities, technical governance forums, and regulatory review processes. Define data architectures for AFC, including domain models, event schemas, lineage, governance, and quality controls. Support implementation of rules engines, anomaly detection, ML models, and risk‑scoring capabilities. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: Essential Skills Proven expertise in delivering architecture and design for modern, cloud‑native AFC platforms and event‑driven architecture. Hands-on design experience with leading KYC/CDD/AML platforms as in-house builds, or vendor platforms like Fenergo, Actimize, Pega, Quantexa, or equivalent. Strong understanding of KYC policy, CDD processes, AML regulations, and customer lifecycle workflows Ability to define and govern target state architectures, reference models, capability maps, and solution blueprints. In depth understanding of key Anti-Financial Crime pillars: Customer Due Diligence / Know your Customer (KYC) Sanctions Screening (customer, payments, entity resolution) Fraud detection and behavioural analytics Case management, investigations, SAR reporting Strong command of data architecture for financial crime, including customer, account, transaction, and risk data models. Demonstrated ability to lead migrations from legacy AFC systems and/or skills in designing data migration strategies Ability to lead architecture workstreams across technology, data, risk, compliance, and operations. Experience supporting design authorities, solutioning guilds, audit and regulatory reviews, and senior stakeholder engagements. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership. Product-oriented engineering mindset with a focus on quality and outcomes. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, regulated financial environment. Analytical and structured problem-solving approach. Desirable skills Experience with banking, payments and/or financial services domain Exposure to machine learning for AFC: anomaly detection, risk scoring, feature stores, explainable AI (XAI). WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN: Be part of a global Financial Crime transformation programme. Work with best-in-class vendor platforms and modern engineering stacks. title: Senior Enterprise Tools Engineer
jobDescription: The Enterprise Tools Data Engineer is a key member of the Engineering team, responsible for designing and implementing data engineering solutions across the enterprise tooling ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, AWS, and Kafka to build scalable data platforms, ingestion frameworks, and Lakehouse architectures that enable analytics, reporting, and AI-driven insights. The engineer will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including architecture, analytics, and business stakeholders, to deliver trusted, performant, and compliant datasets. Key responsibilities Design and build end‑to‑end data ingestion pipelines across Snowflake, Fabric, and AWS. Implement batch and streaming ETL/ELT using SQL, Python, and Kafka. Develop scalable Lakehouse architectures (Bronze → Silver → Gold layers). Optimize pipeline performance, cost efficiency, data reliability, and cloud resource utilization. Apply rigorous data quality practices, automated testing, and engineering standards. Partner with analytics engineers and product teams to deliver trusted, well-modelled datasets. Capture requirements and deliver tailored solutions aligned with business needs. Produce detailed technical documentation for all enhancements and deployments. Conduct knowledge‑sharing sessions to uplift team skills and engineering best practices. Work with LSEG Architecture group in defining potential technology solutions and ensuring adherence to architectural principles. Collaborate with business and functional leads to socialise technology projects and obtain cross functional approvals from Legal, Group Risk, Compliance, LCH Ltd/LCH SA, Candidate Profile / Key Skills Technical Skills Mandatory Skills Strong SQL + Python for ETL/ELT on Snowflake & Fabric Pipelines. Experience with API ingestion + streaming (Kafka/Kinesis). Hands‑on with Lakehouse formats (Parquet/Delta/Iceberg). Solid understanding of cloud data architectures (AWS S3, Glue, Lambda). Data modelling + performance tuning in warehouse/lakehouse environments. Understanding Agile Methodologies Optional Skills Snowpark, Fabric Notebooks, dbt‑style transformation frameworks. Event-driven patterns, schema registry, CDC (if applicable). Good to Have (Dev Ops & Observability) CI/CD for data pipelines, Iaa C basics (Terraform). Data quality/observability tools (Great Expectations, Monte Carlo). Working knowledge of Atlassian tools, Project management tools like Clarity or Planview and Service Now Soft Skills: Strong Planning, organizational and stakeholder management, with confidence to challenge preconceptions of outcomes and solutions. Good communication, presentation, documentation, and customer engagement skills with proven ability to work effectively with all organizational levels. Global experience – working successfully with teams in multiple locations simultaneously. title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobDescription: Our Team We are evolving our Reliability Engineering team to move beyond support and operations. As a Senior Engineer, you will be part of a diverse and inclusive organization that has full ownership of the availability, performance, and scalability of one of the most critical shared services at LSEG. Job Summary The Application Support Engineer (L2) is responsible for providing advanced technical support for business-critical applications. This role handles incident resolution escalated from L1 support, performs root cause analysis, and works closely with development, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure application stability, performance, and availability. Key Responsibilities Provide Level 2 support for production and non-production applications Investigate and resolve application incidents escalated from L1 within SLA Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive fixes Monitor application health, logs, and system performance Execute SQL queries or scripts to analyze and fix data-related issues Support application deployments, releases, and patches Coordinate with development, Dev Ops, DB, and infrastructure teams Document known issues, workarounds, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) Participate in on-call / shift rotations as required Assist in problem management and continuous service improvement Ensure compliance with security, audit, and change management processes Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience) 5–8 years of experience in Application support or Production support Strong understanding of application architecture and support processes Experience with: Incident, problem, and change management (ITIL-based) Log analysis and troubleshooting SQL / database queries (Oracle, My SQL, Postgre SQL, etc.) Linux/Unix and/or Windows environments Familiarity with monitoring tools (Bigpanda, Splunk, Datadog etc.) Good communication and documentation skills Preferred Skills Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) Experience with middleware (Web Logic, Web Sphere, Tomcat, Kafka) Understanding of APIs, microservices, and batch jobs(Autosys) Basic scripting (Shell, Python, Power Shell) ITIL certification Key Competencies Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to work under pressure in production environments Customer-focused mindset Effective collaboration across teams Attention to detail and ownership of issues Does this sound like a challenge you'd be interested in taking on? title: Senior Analyst, Workday VNDLY
jobDescription: At LSEG, we are committed to creating inclusive, intuitive, and reliable People Engineering experiences for colleagues worldwide. We’re looking for a problem-solver who flourishes with improving systems through innovative, out-of-the-box solutions to deliver a best-in-class, seamless user experience. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in designing and implementing engineering solutions focused on automation, efficiency, and resiliency. You’ll collaborate with senior management, partners, and analysts to drive end-to-end solution delivery. Role profile: We are seeking a highly skilled and expert Senior Workday Systems Engineer to join our People Engineering team and lown the design, development, and optimization of external workforce management lifecycle via our Workday VNDLY platform. This role will serve as a technical expert with hands on technical expertise around Workday VNDLY and will partner with the People function, Procurement and other customers to design, develop and implementation of smooth, scalable, secure solutions, aligned with business goals and focused on delivering a best-in-class user experience. ROLE SUMMARY: System Build & Architecture: Lead the technical design and configuration of Workday VNDLY Solutions – specialising in external workforce management lifecycle. Improvements Handle Workday functionality implementations, upgrades, and feature rollouts. Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Workday solutions. Support & Maintenance: Handle sophisticated fix and support for Workday issues with focus on identifying the opportunities to reduce the overall support cases. Monitor system performance and proactively identify areas for improvement. Lead the Testing workstream and collaborate with customers to complete end to end testing Governance & Compliance: Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance with internal policies and external regulations. Maintain documentation for system configurations, integrations, and processes. Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor more junior Workday engineers. Act as a liaison between technical teams and business customers. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Partner with People Functions teams to gather and analyse requirements for external workforce management solutions via Workday VNDLY. Assess existing architecture, workflows, data and provide authoritative recommendations to ensure robust, scalable, solutions. Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to define scope, requirements, timelines, and outcomes for external workforce management initiatives. Design and implement sustainable, efficient, and easy-to-follow configurations in Workday VNDLY, focusing on process simplification and automation. title: Operations Risk Lead
jobDescription: Role Overview This role supports the organisation’s ability to understand, manage, and reduce technology‑related operational risks. It contributes directly to safer, more reliable services across the enterprise by strengthening risk awareness, improving controls, and ensuring that governance practices remain aligned with regulatory and internal expectations. Responsibilities The position focuses on identifying technology operations risks through the analysis of systems, processes, and workflows. It performs structured risk assessments to determine potential impact and likelihood, followed by ongoing reviews to ensure that controls are functioning effectively. It also supports the organisation’s risk governance approach by maintaining alignment with enterprise risk management standards, leading scheduled risk reviews, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and internal policies. The role involves preparing clear reports, dashboards, and documentation that highlight emerging risks, trends, and recommended actions for senior stakeholders. Collaboration with IT, cybersecurity, and cross‑functional teams is central to ensuring timely mitigation and coordinated responses. Maintaining accurate records of assessments, mitigation activities, and compliance evidence is an essential part of the function. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate brings a background in information technology, information security, or a related discipline, supported by 8–10 years of experience in technology operations risk. title: Senior Security Engineer
jobDescription: The Cyber Security Engineering Privileged Access Management team are looking for an independent, pro-active individual who is committed to making an important contribution, to deploy, configure, and maintain PAM platforms to protect privileged accounts and secrets across enterprise infrastructures and cloud services. As a Senior Security Engineer, you will focus on implementing new PAM capabilities, onboarding, operations, automation, and integrations under established architecture and standards. Key Responsibilities Implement PAM capabilities (vaulting, session management/recording, credential rotation, least privilege, EPM/PRA) across on-prem and cloud workloads. Support core PAM features: account discovery/onboarding, credential rotation, policy configuration, and session management. Complete platform maintenance (patching, backups, DR testing), health checks, and performance monitoring; triage incidents and service requests. Integrate PAM with AD/Entra ID, IDPs, ticketing/ITSM, CSPM, SIEM/SOAR, Dev Ops tooling (CI/CD), and secrets management for cloud-native services, assist with workflows and approvals for elevated access. Develop automation scripts (Power Shell/Python) and REST API integrations to scale onboarding and reduce manual effort. Produce and maintain documentation: runbooks, SOPs, configuration baselines, and knowledge articles; chip into compliance evidence. Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to ensure consistent controls and smooth deployments across environments. Technical / job functional knowledge Hands-on experience operating at least one leading PAM platform (e.g., Cyber Ark, Delinea, Beyond Trust, One Identity). Proficient in MS Azure and AWS/GCP cloud platforms. Proven understanding of Windows/Linux administration, AD/Entra ID, networking and database basics, TLS/PKI, and identity integrations. Scripting proficiency (Power Shell/Python) and familiarity with APIs; exposure to Terraform/Cloud automation is a plus. Practical experience in enterprise support: solving, change management, and documenting fixes/runbooks. Additional desired capabilities Exposure to endpoint privilege management, JIT access, secrets management for CI/CD, and container/Kubernetes integrations. Basic familiarity with SIEM tooling and alerting; security certifications or vendor badges are advantageous. title: SOM Enablement Specialist, LDA
jobDescription:
This role is responsible for providing strategic order management support on a regional or global basis for Platform Access Commercial deals. The objective of this position is to provide specialist support linking with key PAC partners including the PAC proposition team, regional PAC leads, SAM Account Teams, Legal teams and Project Managers / GBC’s. Their remit is to understand the details of the individual deals, analyzing the impacts, assessing the required activities to deliver the deal, create project plans and communicate these details to all account owning OMS touching the account globally.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Run all elements of the RAAS Checklist to review account details ahead of implementation. Establishes communication plan with all regional BAU OMS. Run Global Bill for RA customers. Review account to assess the validity of the account hierarchy and identify pre-migration cleanse activities in relation to the existing installed base. Validate current contractual situation in regard to the RMA and associated Schedules. Create RA Commercial billing accounts. Run I055/I110 to special price RA inclusive products to zero. Run asset moves for RA inclusive products to new non-billing accounts. Create relevant quotes for new assets provided to the customer as part of the RA deal. Work with GBC / PM to create legacy to strategic product migration plan. Project lead migration plan with BAU OMS. Prepare RA billing according to customer allocations and validate billing globally through proformas, prior to release and subsequently release billing. Scope and Impact: Is responsible for the creation of the RA order form for presentation to the customer. Pro-actively supports the RA project team to identify potential issues with the account hierarchy. Ensures that once the Order Form is signed, all activities required to create a clean invoice for RA are carried out in a timely manner. Ensures all stakeholders involved in the onboarding of a RA deal are aware of the activities required to successfully process the deal. Co-ordinates regional BAU OMS during migration and RA deal implementation. Ensures commercial requirements are accurately reflected on the client’s billing. Raises all open issues and different requirements arising from RA deals to the Program/Project Manager who will then assign a process expert to the resolution of the issue/requirement. Provides Order Management expertise to the account team prior to and during implementation. Required Skills & Competencies: Excellent communication skills. Flexible and adaptable. Strong organizational skills; strong project management, stakeholder management and people influencing skills. Extensive knowledge and understanding of Refinitiv sales order management process, billing systems and business policies. Ability to analyze, evaluate and make logical decisions. Team focused, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross functional partners to achieve Objectives. Ability to work to tight/demanding deadlines/targets in a fast-paced environment. Shown experience working independently, with demonstrated strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail. title: Lead Engineer
jobDescription: The Cyber Security Engineering Privileged Access Management team are looking for an independent, pro-active, and aspiring individual who is committed to making a meaningful contribution, as a Lead Engineer to lead in the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of enterprise-grade PAM solutions across multi-site and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll serve as a technical authority for PAM, shaping standards, delivering sophisticated migrations, and ensure privileged access is secure, auditable, and resilient. Key Responsibilities Design and implement PAM capabilities (vaulting, session management/recording, credential rotation, least privilege, EPM/PRA) across on-prem and cloud workloads. Lead complex integrations with AD/Entra ID, Id Ps, SIEM/SOAR, CSPM, ITSM, Dev Ops tooling (CI/CD), and secrets management. Be responsible for the operational model: backup/recovery, DR, platform upgrades, policy hardening, performance tuning, and continuous improvement. Drive onboarding at scale ensuring standardized onboarding patterns and controls. Establish guardrails and RBAC/ABAC models aligned to Zero Trust and regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST 800-53/63). Define and maintain technical roadmaps, standards, and reference architectures; mentor engineers and review develop/runbooks. Lead security assessments, threat modeling, and control efficacy reviews; partner with risk/compliance and audit functions on evidence and remediation. Solve complex issues end-to-end, including proxy/connector components, high-availability clusters, and multi-region architectures. Technical / job functional knowledge Consistent record implementing and operating PAM at scale in complex enterprises (multi-site, multi-cloud). Hands-on expertise with at least one of the top PAM vendors (e.g., Cyber Ark, Delinea, Beyond Trust, One Identity), including deployment, integration, and automation. Solid understanding of Windows/Linux administration, AD/Entra ID, networking and database fundamentals (TLS/PKI, proxies, firewalls), and identity protocols (SAML/OIDC/OAuth). Automation proficiency (Power Shell, Python, REST APIs) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Cloud Formation) for repeatable deployments. Experience with SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar) and SOAR integrations for session telemetry, alerts, and response. Proven leadership in defining standards, runbooks, and governance; excellent customer engagement and interpersonal skills. Additional desired capabilities Experience with endpoint privilege management (Windows/mac OS/Linux), JIT access, and Kubernetes/containers. Exposure to segmentation and network security (micro-segmentation, PAM proxies, bastion hosts). Relevant certifications (e.g., Cyber Ark Defender/Sentry, Azure/AWS Security, CISSP, CCSP). experienceProfile.rawText: The Cyber Security Engineering Privileged Access Management team are looking for an independent, pro-active, and aspiring individual who is committed to making a meaningful contribution, as a Lead Engineer to lead in the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of enterprise-grade PAM solutions across multi-site and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). You'll serve as a technical authority for PAM, shaping standards, delivering sophisticated migrations, and ensure privileged access is secure, auditable, and resilient. Key Responsibilities Design and implement PAM capabilities (vaulting, session management/recording, credential rotation, least privilege, EPM/PRA) across on-prem and cloud workloads. Lead complex integrations with AD/Entra ID, Id Ps, SIEM/SOAR, CSPM, ITSM, Dev Ops tooling (CI/CD), and secrets management. Be responsible for the operational model: backup/recovery, DR, platform upgrades, policy hardening, performance tuning, and continuous improvement. Drive onboarding at scale ensuring standardized onboarding patterns and controls. Establish guardrails and RBAC/ABAC models aligned to Zero Trust and regulatory frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST 800-53/63). Define and maintain technical roadmaps, standards, and reference architectures; mentor engineers and review develop/runbooks. Lead security assessments, threat modeling, and control efficacy reviews; partner with risk/compliance and audit functions on evidence and remediation. Solve complex issues end-to-end, including proxy/connector components, high-availability clusters, and multi-region architectures. Technical / job functional knowledge Consistent record implementing and operating PAM at scale in complex enterprises (multi-site, multi-cloud). Hands-on expertise with at least one of the top PAM vendors (e.g., Cyber Ark, Delinea, Beyond Trust, One Identity), including deployment, integration, and automation. Solid understanding of Windows/Linux administration, AD/Entra ID, networking and database fundamentals (TLS/PKI, proxies, firewalls), and identity protocols (SAML/OIDC/OAuth). Automation proficiency (Power Shell, Python, REST APIs) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/Cloud Formation) for repeatable deployments. Experience with SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar) and SOAR integrations for session telemetry, alerts, and response. Proven leadership in defining standards, runbooks, and governance; excellent customer engagement and interpersonal skills. Additional desired capabilities Experience with endpoint privilege management (Windows/mac OS/Linux), JIT access, and Kubernetes/containers. Exposure to segmentation and network security (micro-segmentation, PAM proxies, bastion hosts). Relevant certifications (e.g., Cyber Ark Defender/Sentry, Azure/AWS Security, CISSP, CCSP). title: Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: Role Profile We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to join our Production SRE Support Team within the Markets and Risk Intelligence division. This role focuses on supporting Snowflake environments and ensuring reliability and operational excellence across production and selected non-production environments. The role involves managing testing, build, and implementation of releases, as well as independent infrastructure and environment support. Working within the wider SRE Support Team, the focus will be on delivering the change programme across all lifecycles—from development, test, UAT, Member Test, to Production environments. A production-focused approach is essential, with resilience, operational readiness, performance, and production support at the forefront of delivery. Flexibility to work across different shifts aligned to UK time is expected, with occasional out-of-hours support including nights, weekends, and holidays. The role involves collaborating with business teams for investigations and providing technical guidance when needed. A good understanding of underlying technologies and the ability to assist developers with fixes or enhancements is important. The ideal candidate should be dedicated and able to manage priorities effectively without rigid oversight. Key Responsibilities Operational Support Monitor and maintain Snowflake databases and related infrastructure for performance, availability, and reliability. Participate in incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Maintain and improve documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures. Participate in shift rotations and occasional out-of-hours support. Deployment & Automation Implement releases and changes across development, test, and production environments. Apply standard processes for database administration, including backups, recovery, and security. Automate deployment and maintenance tasks using Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, Cloud Formation). Develop scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency. Monitoring & Performance Configure and maintain monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Datadog) to ensure system health. Analyze system performance and implement improvements for cost efficiency and resilience. Collaboration Work closely with developers and product teams to embed reliability into the software lifecycle. Contribute to knowledge sharing and team documentation. Support global SRE initiatives and cross-regional collaboration. Person Specification Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field or equivalent practical experience. Required Skills and Experience 3–6 years of experience in SRE, Dev Ops, or related roles. Hands-on experience with Snowflake or other database technologies. Proficiency in SQL and basic query optimization. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, Cloud Formation). Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Power Shell. Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and Dev Ops practices. Experience with monitoring tools (Datadog or similar) and ITSM platforms (Service Now preferred). Good communication and problem-solving skills. Personal Attributes Technically curious and detail-oriented. Detail-oriented and proactive in identifying reliability improvements. Strong collaboration skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Passionate about automation, reliability, and continuous improvement. Benefits LSEG offers a competitive compensation package, including equity, annual bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and vision coverage. title: Control Advisory Manager
jobDescription:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive professional to join Control Utility as a Control Advisory Manager who would be responsible to assist Division / Corporate Function Business Control Officers and Control Owners by designing effective controls that a Control Owner will be accountable to implement and monitor quality. This role is responsible in designing, engineering, and remediating controls as assigned to ensure they are sustainable and compliant with control standards. The successful candidate will partner with the relevant Risk and Control owners to ensure the right controls are implemented with a strong focus on automation, measurement, and efficiency. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Act as a trusted advisor to Division/Function on control-related matters, providing expert guidance on control design and remediation. Review and assess process changes, new initiatives, and projects for control implications, ensuring alignment with enterprise control standards. Design and engineer controls to strengthen risk mitigation. Recommend and implement sustainable controls that meet requirements and industry best practices. Lead remediation efforts as assigned for control deficiencies, ensuring timely and effective resolution in partnership with relevant stakeholders. Develop and maintain comprehensive control documentation, including risk and control matrices, documentation to ensure effective operationalisation of controls. Provide training and awareness sessions to enhance control knowledge across the organisation to promote a healthy risk culture. Contribute to control testing strategies, support Risk Self-Assessments (CSAs), and leverage data analytics for continuous monitoring. Assist in Control Testing and Operations as needed Stay abreast of regulatory expectations, emerging risks, and industry trends in control automation and governance. Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Accounting, Business, or related field; relevant professional certifications. 8–12 years of experience in risk management, internal controls, audit, or control advisory roles. Proven expertise in control design, remediation, and automation, including engineering preventive and detective controls. Strong understanding of control frameworks (e.g. COSO, SOX, COBIT). Experience in process mapping, risk assessment, and implementing technology-enabled controls. Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams. Preferred Skills Experience in operational risk or control advisory within a global organisation. Familiarity with data analytics tools and control automation technologies. title: Senior Assocaite Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
jobDescription: We’re looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our LSEG’s (London Stock Exchange Group) Real Time SRE team. As part of the SRE team, you will play a central role in supporting our large, globally-distributed market data infrastructure. You’ll be responsible for providing support for critical Real Time applications, identifying and automating away development and operational toil, and driving adoption of the latest and greatest tools and platforms. Ideal candidates will be strong individual contributors, possess a mix of operational support and development skills, have experience working with complex distributed systems, have strong written and verbal communication skills, and have experience scaling complex technical solutions. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING: Working across multiple functions (infrastructure, networks, data quality, and development teams) to ensure service health for LSEG clients Ensure end-to-end quality for application migrations to cloud, from high-quality documentation, to observability flows, to operational acceptance testing and beyond Support a diverse set of applications deployed across on-premise data centers, public and private cloud (AWS/Azure) Automating operational and development toil via scripting skills and familiarity with Git Leverage the latest tools and develop processes to accelerate LSEG’s response to and recovery from service-impacting incidents Crafting reusable dashboards and alerting pipelines from raw metrics and logs Integrate cloud services, tooling platforms, and process automation together to accelerate Mean Time to Detection and Resolution for incidents Designing, authoring, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and patterns Define Service Level Objectives and implement monitoring to ensure our systems are available and healthy WHAT YOU'LL BRING: At least 5 years of hands-on industry experience in Dev Ops or SRE, or relevant equivalent (experience in supporting financial markets, real-time data, or client-facing applications a plus) Hands-on experience supporting cloud applications (AWS/Azure preferred) Fluent in writing well-documented, production-grade Python code Excellent grasp of key components of the software development lifecycle, including testing, code quality and security scans, artifact versioning, environment promotion, and deployment models Strong background in Unix/Linux concepts, configuration, and shell scripting Experience in working with container-based technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, and managed services like Azure AKS and AWS EKS) Experience deploying changes to large, distributed systems in both cloud and on-premises Excellent practical and theoretical knowledge of Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery pipelines (CI/CD), sufficient to design, author, and maintain CI/CD codebases Experience designing and implementing observability components like alerts, dashboards, monitors, log-parsing pipelines, and automated remediation flows (experience with Data Dog is a plus) Detail-oriented approach to writing crystal-clear technical documentation WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN: Experience coordinating business-critical technical initiatives at a massive scale Hands on expertise supporting low-latency market data applications Work on cutting-edge platforms and initiatives that keep your skills at the forefront of the industry Exposure to a wide range of technologies, tools, and cloud providers The support of a dynamic and growing team interested always interested in sharpening our skills We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible, and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. title: Manager, Cyber Security
jobDescription: Role Purpose The Cyber Security Engineering IAM & PAM team are looking for an independent, pro-active, and aspiring individual who is committed to making a meaningful contribution, as a PAM/IAM support engineer team lead. They will play a leading role utilising their technical and leadership experience to enhance IAM / PAM solutions that best fit our business requirements. The team are a part of the Cyber Security Engineering function who are developing cyber defence capabilities to protect the business from cyber threats which seek to impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the group. Reports to Director IAM & PAM Architecture, Cyber Security Direct reports Leads a small team May manage contingents and vendor/partner resources in their deliveries. Key relationships & committees Stakeholders include the wider security team including security architecture, Identity and Access Management, cyber strategy business function, governance, risk and compliance, programme management. Entity level Business Information Security Officers (BISOs). Infrastructure & Cloud operations, engineering, and architecture teams. Internal risk and audit functions. Architecture and corporate approval forums. External partners/vendors, and industry schemes. Location / flexible working Bengaluru – Hybrid Working Responsibilities Key responsibilities Contribute to domain strategies and architectures, leads on engineering and the associated artefacts across the areas of identity & access management, privileged access management and secrets management technology. Be responsible for the controls related to the domain area and ensure they remain effective. Lead and deliver smaller scale projects or discrete workstreams for larger projects as part of the cyber programme and other initiatives. Manage and deliver changes to controls as necessary which are not part of project activity. Develop key indicators, analysis and artefacts to continually evidence and report control effectiveness and risk for the group. Critical issue support for any operational incident from operations or global security operations centre for related domain technologies. Accountable for ongoing activities and objectives of the team. Solve complex problems related to the area. Remain current with principles, concepts and emerging technologies related to the role. Leadership responsibilities The role holder will lead a small team, responsible for supporting the IAM and PAM team as second line. They will be accountable for delivering quality service, robust processes and will cover all aspects of team management, supported by the Senior Manager, such as reviews, shift management and reward. Critical work Delivery of activities against of agreed cyber security strategies. Shapes project delivery with the project management team and the senior manager of the domain area. Delivery of key artefacts associated with the role, artefacts support evidencing and assurance activities. Ongoing control operation and effectiveness and evidencing of such. Reporting, development and management of agreed measures, key performance indicators and key risk indicators. Manage and support a small team to deliver consistent service outcomes and foster continuing development Impact As a group level function, the role has impact across all parts of the business as it has responsibility for the relevant security controls seeking to mitigate the risk and impact to the group from cyber-attacks. Impacts include financial, economic, regulatory, customer and brand. The role is key to addressing regulatory concerns for all our regulated entities related to cyber security and cyber resilience. Key critical metrics Delivery of projects and BAU activities within agreed timescales to the required standard. Issues that are identified are fixed and remain fixed and are not recurring. Key artefacts for the activities performed exist, are accurate and of required standard. Agreed measures related to controls owned by the role, for example Key Risk Indicators, are delivered and managed. Technical / job functional knowledge Knowledge and experience in the engineering and operation of privileged access management (PAM) and Identity Access Management (IAM) technologies and concepts and the integration with relevant platforms. Level of knowledge in the domain technology area would be considered competent. Has proven experience in managing and developing direct reports to achieve operational goals. Knowledge of different operating systems, platforms, and applications where relevant for the domain area and implications for those platforms. Level of knowledge would be considered proficient. Engineering of layered control capabilities. An understanding of information security principles and standard methodologies. A good understanding of Adversary Tools, Techniques and Procedures (TTP’s) is required. Knowledge in domain area and basic knowledge across non-core domain areas. Modern engineering practices, automation to drive efficiencies. Infrastructure as Code mentality. Code / scripting for practical tasks and tool integrations. Structured and methodical problem-solving practices for resolving sophisticated problems. Policies, standards and security frameworks, NIST, CIS. Strong skills to author formal documentation. Understanding of security metrics to measure control operation and risk. The position holder works independently with minimal guidance and is expected to solve problems with sound judgement and in a way that is aligned to good practice and in the long-term interests of LSEG. The role holder is likely to hold one or more of the following security or engineering/architecture specific certifications, CISSP, OSCP, TOGAF, GIAC or other relevant qualification. Business and sector expertise Experience and knowledge of technology in financial services and/or regulated environments and industry compliance schemes (for example SWIFT) preferred. Will have experience of working in security focussed roles. Likely will have greater than 5 years full time in security, in an overall career in technology of around 8 years, focussed predominantly in this specialised area. Expected to have direct hands-on experience in some of the domain area technologies. Leadership and management experience Experience in advocating for and inspiring change to reach the best outcome according to the needs of the organisation, customers and industry trends. Personal skills and capabilities Collaborating across the group to deliver successful balanced outcomes for the group and its partners. Inspire team to deliver secure, meaningful results through purposeful leadership and collaboration. Takes ownership and commits to delivering sustainable outcomes and resolving problems. Demonstrates a bias for action. Consistent track record of delivering results without compromising on quality. Critical thinker, takes in broad perspectives to assess and make decisions. Willingness and flexibility and to work across different technologies. Capability to quickly assimilate new concepts and technologies. Takes ownership of own career development and learning. Supports colleagues with less experience to help in their professional growth. Adapts messaging and presentation styles to the requirements of the audience. Is measured and considered in complicated and fast paced situations. Diversity & Inclusion People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our colleagues thrive personally and professionally through our shared values of Integrity, Partnership, Innovation and Excellence are at the core of our culture. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract people with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We are always looking at ways to become more agile, so we meet the needs of our teams and customers. title: Senior Vulnerability Management Engineer
jobDescription: LSEG is seeking a Senior Vulnerability Management Engineer to join our internal offensive security team with focus on driving closure of penetration testing findings. This role bridges offensive security and engineering by translating penetration test results into clear, actionable remediation guidance and partnering with application and platform teams to implement secure fixes. The successful candidate has a strong penetration testing or application security background, hands on remediation experience, and the ability to coordinate multiple collaborators to reduce risk at scale. This is a highly technical, delivery focused role with responsibility for both individual findings and systemic improvements. Key Responsibilities Analyze and review penetration test reports to understand technical impact, exploitability, and business risk. Develop, document and maintain remediation guidance, patterns, and blue-prints for common vulnerability types (e.g. injections, access control, auth, session management, misconfigurations). Provide consultation to application and platform teams on secure design and remediation approaches, including code-level, configuration-level and business-level recommendations. Coordinate remediation activities across multiple teams, ensuring, clear ownership, agreed timelines, and risk-based prioritization. Validate fixes by retesting vulnerabilities (manually and/or via tools/scripts) and updating the status of findings through closure. Manage and track the remediation backlog, including SLAs, aging finings, and critical issues when needed. Produce and maintain documentation on remediation processes, workflows, and controls for audit and compliance purposes. Prepare and deliver regular status reports and metrics on remediation progress, trends, and risk reduction to management and partners. Perform root cause analysis for recurring or systemic issues and work with engineering, architecture, and governance teams to implement long-term corrective actions. Contribute to continuous improvement of the pentest-to-remediation lifecycle, including automation, standardization and integration with SDLC/Dev Sec Ops pipelines. Compile technical documents, track and document remediation metadata Engagement details (who, what, when, where) Testing team members and roles Tools and methodologies used Schedule and timelines Target systems and environments Constraints, exclusions, and limitations Testing activities and event logs Contribute to team improvement efforts and ensure all initiatives and feedback are well documented for future references. Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methodologies, tooling, automation. Stay ahead of with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and offensive security techniques. Participate in R&D initiatives as guided from leadership. Support knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team. Required Skills & Experience Proven hands-on experience in penetration testing of Web Applications, APIs, Thick Client and Common Infrastructures (Active Directory, Cloud and Cloud-native based environments). Proficiency with tools such as Burp Suite, common command-line tools, and ability to write custom scripts when needed. Experience in automating pentesting tasks. Solid understanding of application security, network protocols, and operating systems. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes). Solid understanding of common vulnerabilities and exposures (OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25) and secure coding practices in at least on major language stack (e.g. Java/Springboot, .NET, Java Script/Node, Python) Ability to write clear, technical reports and communicate findings and fixes to both technical and non-technical partners. Experience working in large, complex enterprise environments. Proficient communication skills in English, both written and verbal. Relevant certifications and engagement with the security community is a plus Threat Modelling experience is a plus. Proven track record of successfully managing and driving security engagements for various organizations with differing operational and technical profiles. Ability to identify, assess, and communicate technical and project risks to partners. Understanding project requirements and aligning work with agreed upon objectives and timelines. title: Data Platform Administrator
jobDescription: We are seeking a skilled and proactive Data Platform Administrator to manage, monitor, and optimize our cloud data platform environment. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with cloud-based data platforms, strong knowledge of Spark, big data or related technologies, and a passion for enabling data teams to work efficiently and securely. Key Responsibilities- Platform Administration Handle and maintain workspaces, clusters, pools, and jobs in Databricks or other big data systems. Monitor performance, usage, and costs; optimize cluster configurations. Security & Compliance Configure role-based access control (RBAC), and audit logging. Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards. Automation & Dev Ops Develop CI/CD pipelines for notebooks, jobs, and libraries using tools like Gitlab, Git Hub Actions, Azure Dev Ops, or Jenkins. Automate cluster lifecycle management and job scheduling. Support & Troubleshooting Provide support to the users of the platform i.e., data scientists, engineers, and analysts. Troubleshoot job failures, performance bottlenecks, and integration issues. Integration & Collaboration Integrate Databricks with other enterprise systems (e.g., Azure Data Lake, Power BI, Dataverse). Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred, AWS or GCP acceptable). Familiarity with Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, and Lakehouse architecture. Proficiency in Python, SQL, and shell scripting. Experience with CI/CD tools and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform is a plus). Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. You will work closely with various groups to ensure successful delivery of new SOC 2 / ISAE 3000 attestations! What you’ll be doing: Leadership & Culture: Champion integrity, transparency, and continuous learning across the team. Mentor members of staff, encourage growth, through real-time feedback and collaborative learning. Support the team in adapting to new auditing standards and digital transformation initiatives. Prepare and deliver responses to findings. Take a lead on the day to day management and scheduling of the DORA Customer Attestation program, ensuring that all internal partners are briefed, logistics organised, and evidence collated. Control framework: Support the development and implementation of control frameworks over technology platforms from each Business Unit. Collaborate with product managers, engineers, architects and partners to help implement controls for attestations. Conduct self-assessment and risk reviews. Act as main point of contact for Business Unit Product Managers, Business Control Owners, Architects and others. Maintain and collaborate with partners – including Infrastructure & Cloud, D&A Tech Services teams, product teams, customer facing teams and external auditors. Risk and Compliance: Collaborate with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, and other internal Program teams to align on regulatory expectations. Supervise emerging standards in financial market infrastructure assurance and recommend adoption where required. Primary skills: Proven track record in audit, attestation, or risk assurance in a Big 4, consulting or financial services environment.
